jobs.title: English to German (Switzerland) Review Lead for UI, Marketing & Product Content
jobs.description:
English to German (Switzerland) Review Lead for UI, Marketing & Product Content

About Welo Global 

Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo Global’s five brands—Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)—serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com  


The Role 

We are seeking an experienced English into German (Switzerland) Review Lead to serve as the language quality owner and primary client-facing linguistic expert for a leading global technology client. 

You will own the locale’s interpretation of the client’s quality standards and make sure that the Post-Editing Lead, Post Editors, and Reviewers all work to the same shared understanding of “good”. You will be the main point of contact for the client’s Language Manager on quality discussions, arbitration, and escalations, and you will drive consistency, quality governance, and continuous improvement across UI, marketing, product, informational, legal, and support content. 

Project Details 

- Location: Remote (based in one of the approved countries below)
- Expected volume: Approximately 24 hours per month
- Employment type: Freelance / Independent Contract
- Task type: Language Lead Support
- Content types: UI, Marketing, Informational, Legal, Product, Support
- Language pair: English into German from Switzerland

What You Will Do 

-Analyse requirements: Review every style guide and glossary update, assess which quality categories and content types it affects, and record the changes. Track what the client’s Language Manager actually corrects and says in calibration and quality calls, not only what is written down.
-Relay expectations: Run regular alignment roundtables with the language community and publish a structured monthly quality digest covering performance, priority improvement areas, style guide updates, and notable errors and arbitration outcomes.
-Manage review quality actively: Coach Reviewers one-to-one using specific examples, run shadowing sessions, and deliver training built from real alignment data.
-Improve the standard: Turn recurring justification patterns into well-reasoned style guide proposals, and share cross-locale patterns with the Welocalize Quality Manager.
-Maintain alignment with the client: Treat Language Manager decisions as the standard, raise concerns with evidence at the right forum, and aim for fewer surprises over time.

What You Will Own

-The locale’s review service score, including RQE audit and alignment performance
-The community’s shared understanding of quality 
-The integrity of the arbitration record, ensuring that every arbitration sent to the client is valid and well-evidenced
-The working relationship with the client’s Language Manager, including clarifications, escalations, and expectation tracking

Requirements

- Experience: 3 to 5+ years in Localization Quality Assurance (LQA), Senior Language Lead, or Quality Governance roles
- Client and stakeholder management: Direct experience as the primary point of contact for client Language Managers, managing formal arbitration or escalation processes, and facilitating conflict resolution
- Quality audit frameworks: Deep, practical experience with localization evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mapping
- Style guide and expectation analysis: Ability to analyse style guide changes, identify implicit client expectations, and map tolerance by content type (for example, Marketing vs. Legal vs. UI)
- Meeting facilitation: Hands-on experience with one-to-one coaching, shadowing sessions, alignment roundtables, and structured monthly quality reporting
- Analytical approach: Skill in tracking error concentrations, severity drift, and alignment scores, and in converting justification patterns into style guide improvements
- Language: Native-level German (Switzerland) and professional-level English
- Preferred: Prior experience supporting major technology localization programs and working with calibration or alignment tools

Additional Key Information 

- Successful candidates will be provided with a dedicated device for project work.
- A background check is required as part of onboarding.
- Candidates must be physically located in one of the approved countries.

Approved countries: Argentina, Australia, Austria, Belgium, Brazil, Bulgaria, Canada, Chile, China, Colombia, Costa Rica, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Egypt, El Salvador, Finland, France, Germany, Ghana, Greece, Guatemala, Hong Kong, Hungary, India, Indonesia, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, Kenya, Lithuania, Malaysia, Mexico, Netherlands, New Zealand, Nigeria, Norway, Peru, Philippines, Poland, Portugal, Qatar, Romania, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, South Africa, South Korea, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Taiwan, Thailand, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, United States and Vietnam.  

Why Join Us 

This role offers a long-term partnership with global teams on high-visibility products. You will benefit from steady project volume, comprehensive onboarding and ongoing upskilling, and access to established linguistic resources. 

If this sounds like the right opportunity, we would love to hear from you. 

Job Reference: #LI-JC1

The Technical Customer Support Associate works within the Technical Support department to provide support for customers related to the installation, troubleshooting and integration of Jamf products and supporting technologies. The Technical Customer Support Associate provides direct assistance to Jamf product users and is responsible for fielding customer inquiries via phone, chat, email, among other outreach methods directly from customers, as well as delivering technical and account support to Jamf customers with an emphasis on first-touch issue resolution.

AI Software Engineer

Zone & Company Software Consulting LLC (“Zone”) is the ERP-native AI platform for financial operations, purpose-built for organizations running on Oracle NetSuite. We are redefining how finance teams operate by delivering an AI-powered system that automates, connects, and scales financial workflows directly within the ERP.

As the AI operating system for finance teams in NetSuite, Zone enables more than 4,500 customers worldwide to run smarter, faster, and with greater accuracy. Our platform spans the full financial lifecycle, including Quote-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Treasury, Payroll Management, and Record-to-Report, eliminating manual processes and unlocking real-time financial intelligence.

By embedding intelligence directly into NetSuite, Zone helps finance teams move beyond reactive work to proactive, strategic impact. Learn more at www.zoneandco.com or follow us on LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/zoneandco.

About the Job:

Zone & Co is seeking a skilled AI Software Engineer to join our fast-paced, innovation-driven development team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying AI solutions that power and enhance our business products and operations. You’ll collaborate closely with product, data science, and engineering teams to build scalable, production-ready AI systems that deliver real business value. This is an exciting opportunity for a technically curious and creative problem-solver who is passionate about artificial intelligence, continuous learning, and delivering high-impact outcomes.

What You'll Do:

  • 2+ years of software engineering experience with a focus on AI/ML applications.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or related field (Master’s preferred).

  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, agents, and frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, or DSPy.

  • Strong communication skills in English—both written and verbal.

jobs.description:
Performance Marketing Manager - Paid Social (m/f/d)

About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health. 

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US. 

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.


Role overview

As Performance Marketing Manager – Paid Social, you will own Hilo’s paid social strategy and performance across our key markets and prepare the channel for Hilo’s next stage of growth. Creative strategy is a core driver of paid social performance: You turn customer insight and campaign data into compelling concepts, run a rigorous testing program and work with creative partners to bring the strongest ideas to market.

You connect that work to measurable business outcomes, improving conversion and return on investment while making sure every health claim is accurate and approved.

Reporting to the Head of Performance Marketing, you will play a key role in our performance marketing team, working with internal teams and external partners to drive growth.

Work location: Our company operates on a remote-first model. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in Europe. Fluent English and German are a must. Occasional travel to our office in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, or to team events may be required.

Core responsibilities

  • Lead paid social strategy, planning and execution across the US, UK, Germany and other growth markets.
  • Develop creative hypotheses based on customer research, market differences and performance data.
  • Brief, test and refine ad concepts, messages, formats and landing pages in partnership with creative and product teams.
  • Manage campaign budgets, audiences and optimisation across Meta, TikTok and other relevant platforms.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey and conversion rate, from ad click through to purchase.
  • Measure performance against acquisition cost, revenue and return on investment and turn findings into clear decisions and next steps.
  • Work with clinical, regulatory and legal colleagues to ensure advertising claims and health messaging are accurate and approved.
  • Steer agencies and freelancers, set clear priorities and ensure high-quality execution and continuous performance improvement.

Requirements

Background & Experience

  • At least 5 years of hands-on paid social experience in an international setting, including direct ownership of campaigns and budgets.
  • Strong creative strategy skills and a track record of turning insights into ads that perform.
  • A data-driven approach to testing, measurement, and decision-making.
  • Experience improving conversion rates and managing campaigns against ROI goals.
  • Deep knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and experience with other relevant social platforms.
  • Ability to adapt messaging and execution across markets while keeping the brand consistent.
  • Clear communication and sound judgment when working with sensitive health topics.
  • Nice to have: experience in health tech, medical devices, wearables, or subscription products.

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do: 

Move the Needle — You focus on what truly drives impact for our customers and company. You use data and clarity to guide your decisions and prioritize what matters most. You push boundaries with bold, thoughtful innovation and hold yourself accountable for results.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with high quality. You treat mistakes as learning opportunities, experiment thoughtfully and iterate quickly. jobs.title: Commissioning & Field Deployment Engineer
jobs.description:
Commissioning & Field Deployment Engineer

At Hive, we're building the defining physical AI platform of the next decade.

Industrial labor is one of the most acute bottlenecks in the global economy. Operators are expensive, hard to retain, and working in environments that are increasingly unsafe. The shortage is structural. The window to solve it is now.

Our answer is a machine-agnostic intelligence platform that lets any machine, on any site, perceive, decide, and act autonomously. One platform. Any machine. No fleet replacement.

Already live across multiple sites and customers in Europe - spanning logistics and warehousing, industrial manufacturing, and large-scale chemical production - with a US expansion underway.

The vision: one operator managing hundreds of machines simultaneously. Productive machine-hour cost dropping by 80x, and unlocks the next productivity revolution in physical work.

The mission is to make productivity limitless. Come and help us build it.

 

The Role

As Commissioning & Field Deployment Engineer, you will be responsible for the hands-on installation, integration, testing and commissioning of Hive systems, mainly at customer sites.

You will work directly on industrial machines alongside Hive Engineering and Delivery, taking systems from physical installation through technical commissioning and operational readiness.

This is a field-focused engineering role for someone comfortable combining mechanical, electrical and software-based troubleshooting in real industrial environments.

What You Will Do

Install & Integrate Hive Systems

  • Perform mechanical and electrical installation of Hive equipment on industrial machines.

  • Install, connect and verify system hardware and related components.

  • Build, modify and troubleshoot wiring, harnesses, brackets and installation components when required.

  • Verify installations against drawings, specifications and quality requirements.

  • Prepare machines and equipment for commissioning and deployment.

Commission Systems

  • Perform system configuration, calibration and commissioning.

  • Execute commissioning procedures, functional testing and technical verification.

  • Verify that system components and machine interfaces operate correctly.

  • Diagnose and resolve installation, configuration and commissioning issues.

  • Document commissioning results, issues and corrective actions.

  • Support final validation and readiness for customer operation.

Support Customer Deployments

  • Travel to customer sites across the UK to install and commission Hive solutions.

  • Work closely with the Deployment Manager, Engineering and customer teams during deployment.

  • Troubleshoot technical issues in active industrial environments.

  • Support testing, validation, acceptance and go-live activities.

  • Provide hands-on technical support during the early stages of customer operations.

Improve How We Deploy

  • Improve installation and commissioning procedures based on field experience.

  • Identify recurring issues and feed practical improvements back to Engineering.

  • Help develop tools, documentation and checklists for future deployments.

  • Support preparation of machines and equipment at Hive's UK facility.

  • Help establish a high standard for installation quality, commissioning and field execution.

What We're Looking For

Essential

  • Hands-on experience with mechanical, electrical or electromechanical systems.

  • Experience installing, commissioning, maintaining or troubleshooting industrial equipment.

  • Strong practical troubleshooting skills.

  • Comfortable reading technical drawings, wiring diagrams and installation documentation.

  • Experience working with electrical wiring, sensors, control systems or industrial electronics.

  • Comfortable using computers and software-based diagnostic or configuration tools.

  • Strong attention to quality and safety.

  • Able to work independently and solve problems in the field.

  • Comfortable working directly with customers and other technical teams.

  • Willingness to travel extensively across the UK.

  • Authorized to work in the UK.

Strongly preferred

Experience with one or more of:

  • Industrial automation

  • Robotics or autonomous systems

  • Heavy equipment

  • Forklifts or material-handling equipment

  • Construction or mining machinery

  • Automotive or off-highway equipment

  • Field service engineering

  • Controls or electrical systems

  • Sensor installation and calibration

  • Linux-based systems

  • Industrial networking

Experience commissioning complex systems in customer environments is a major advantage.

Who Thrives at Hive

  • You prefer working on real machines over sitting behind a desk.

  • You enjoy figuring out why something doesn't work — and fixing it.

  • You are comfortable combining mechanical, electrical and software troubleshooting.

  • You take pride in clean, reliable installations and high-quality field work.

  • You work well in fast-moving environments where not every problem has a documented solution.

  • You want to help build a field engineering capability from the ground up.

This is an opportunity to play a direct role in bringing Hive's technology from engineering into real industrial operations across the UK.

Why Join Hive?

Join Hive at a pivotal stage as we expand into the UK and build a new category in Physical AI. You’ll work with cutting-edge autonomy technology and a highly experienced team to bring autonomous industrial machines out of development and into real-world commercial operations.

As we establish and scale our UK operations, you’ll have the opportunity to take on significant responsibility from day one, help shape how we operate in the UK, and build the playbooks for deploying and operating autonomous machines at scale..

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Early applications are encouraged. Hive values diversity and encourages qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation or background.

Account Executive

Zone & Company Software Consulting LLC (“Zone”) is the ERP-native AI platform for financial operations, purpose-built for organizations running on Oracle NetSuite. We are redefining how finance teams operate by delivering an AI-powered system that automates, connects, and scales financial workflows directly within the ERP.

As the AI operating system for finance teams in NetSuite, Zone enables more than 4,500 customers worldwide to run smarter, faster, and with greater accuracy. Our platform spans the full financial lifecycle, including Quote-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Treasury, Payroll Management, and Record-to-Report, eliminating manual processes and unlocking real-time financial intelligence.

By embedding intelligence directly into NetSuite, Zone helps finance teams move beyond reactive work to proactive, strategic impact. Learn more at www.zoneandco.com or follow us on LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/zoneandco.

About the Job:

As an Account Executive at Zone & Co, you'll play a key role in driving our continued growth by bringing new customers into our business. You'll own the full sales cycle—from prospecting and pipeline generation through negotiation and close—working with high-value prospects across a defined territory.

This is an opportunity for a driven SaaS sales professional who thrives on winning new business, building meaningful customer relationships, and consistently exceeding targets. You'll partner closely with Solution Consultants, Marketing, Product, Professional Services, and Partner teams to deliver value-driven solutions that solve complex business challenges for finance leaders.

If you're energized by fast-paced environments, enjoy taking ownership of your results, and are motivated by building a strong pipeline and closing deals, we'd love to hear from you!

What You'll Do:

  • Own and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) targets across multiple products within your assigned territory.
  • Prospect and generate new business opportunities through outbound outreach, networking, referrals, and strategic partnerships.
  • Manage the full sales cycle, from discovery and qualification through proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline, effectively managing multiple opportunities at various stages while maintaining accurate forecasting.
  • Apply a consultative, value-based sales approach to understand customer challenges and position tailored solutions that deliver business value.
  • Partner with Solution Consultants to deliver compelling product demonstrations and ensure a seamless transition from sale to implementation.
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Product, Partner & Alliance, and Professional Services teams to drive pipeline growth and deliver an exceptional customer experience.
  • Maintain accurate opportunity management, forecasting, and sales activity within Salesforce and other sales enablement tools.
  • Leverage sales methodologies, including MEDDPICC, to qualify opportunities and navigate complex buying processes.
  • Build relationships with finance executives and other key stakeholders, acting as a trusted advisor throughout the buying journey.
  • Provide customer feedback and market insights to help inform product strategy and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure all sales activities are conducted ethically and in compliance with company policies and applicable regulations.

What You'll Need:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in a net-new SaaS sales role with a track record of consistently exceeding annual ARR quotas of $1M+.
  • Experience selling into upper mid-market and/or enterprise organizations.
  • Demonstrated success building pipeline through proactive prospecting and outbound business development.
  • Experience managing complex sales cycles using structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC.
  • Ability to engage multiple stakeholders and align technology solutions to complex business challenges.
  • Experience selling to finance leaders and the Office of the CFO is highly preferred.
  • Experience selling financial software solutions such as billing, reporting, payroll, payments, AP automation, Procure-to-Pay, or Order-to-Cash solutions is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS and financial technology solutions.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Experience using Salesforce, Gong, and other modern sales technology platforms.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to prioritize effectively.
  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to thrive in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Willingness to travel as needed for customer meetings and industry events.
  • Must be located and living in Australia

What makes you successful:

  • Results-driven and motivated by achieving ambitious goals.
  • Customer-focused, with a consultative approach to solving business challenges.
  • Competitive, resilient, and energized by winning new business.
  • Adaptable and comfortable navigating change in a high-growth environment.
  • Coachable and committed to continuous learning and improvement.
  • Accountable, proactive, and willing to take ownership of outcomes.

Benefits

At Zone, we provide the platform; you provide the grit. We operate as a high-velocity, fully remote, global team where autonomy isn't just a perk, it’s the standard. We’re looking for self-driven professionals eager to navigate the complexities of a unique SaaS environment and take full command of their professional evolution.

We ditch micro-management for high-trust flexibility, ensuring you have the space to innovate and scale. Our benefits are built to fuel this lifestyle, supporting your life beyond the screen so you can focus on making a global impact. Explore our offerings at https://www.zoneandco.com/careers

Join Our Global Mission

Zone & Co is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. We thrive on unique perspectives and strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Here, your identity is valued, and your talent is the only limit to your growth. All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, religion, sex, orientation, age, disability, or any other protected factor.

Employment Terms

Employment with Zone is “At-Will”, meaning either party may terminate the relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, in accordance with applicable law. This job description does not constitute an employment contract or guarantee of continued employment. Duties and responsibilities may evolve as the company grows and may change at any time with or without notice.

jobs.description:
Software Engineer (Data)

Our Mission

We’re not your average benefits platform – we’re the driving force that uplifts people’s lives. Our technology connects the entire benefits ecosystem, creating better outcomes for employers, employees, brokers, and providers.

Our mission is clear: to build a world where everything works at its best, ensuring every employee gets the support they need to thrive—both at work and beyond.

Your Mission

As our Software Engineer (Data), you’ll build and run the pipelines, orchestration, and infrastructure that move data across Ben: in from our product and the tools we use, in from our customers, and back out to them again. It’s the plumbing the whole company and our customers depend on, and it has to stay reliable. We serve global enterprise customers with strict security and reliability requirements.

You’ll own real work from day one. You’ll have a strong team of cross functional engineers alongside you, room to grow into harder problems, and the freedom to do the job your way.

What you’ll be working on

  • Own everything that flows into Ben: build and maintain the ingestion pipelines that bring data into our warehouse, with Fivetran for managed sources and custom pipelines where we need them.

  • Keep everything running on time: own the orchestration that keeps data moving on schedule and recovers cleanly when something breaks.

  • Scale and manage our data infrastructure: build and manage our data infrastructure as code with Terraform, using mainly AWS services.

  • Connect Ben to every system our customers run: build enterprise-grade pipelines and connectors for our customers, bringing their data in, for example from HR and payroll systems, and getting accurate data back out to them, reliably and securely, even at the volumes large customers bring.

  • Build the data layer our agents act on: help connect our data to the AI agents and services we're building, including through MCP connectors, so they get the right context at the right time.

  • Shape what we build: work with product and other stakeholders to scope problems and agree on simple but scalable solutions.

  • Build it to enterprise standard: build to current security practice, for example the OWASP Top 10 and the AWS Well-Architected Framework.

Behind the scenes

Ben runs on Python 3, Django, PostgreSQL, and React, on AWS.

Our data platform today is built around Fivetran, AWS DMS or custom pipelines for ingestion, dbt for transformation, PostgreSQL on AWS RDS as the warehouse, and n8n or AWS Lambda for automation between systems. We manage our infrastructure as code with Terraform and use different AWS services depending on requirements.

We have adopted frontier level agentic development practices and continue to push the envelope of what’s possible with current technologies.

Your skills and experience

  • Strong experience with Python and SQL.

  • A few years building and running production data pipelines that other people relied on.

  • Comfortable with infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform, and hands-on with AWS, for example Lambda, ECS, Glue, S3, RDS.

  • A good grasp of ETL/ELT and orchestration.

  • Experience building or running data integrations and connectors, especially ones that other companies or customers depend on, is a real plus.

  • Solid software engineering fundamentals: clean code, sensible design, and tests you can rely on.

  • You keep security in mind when you build applications and configure infrastructure, and you know what enterprise customers expect of their data.

Nice to have, not essential:

  • Experience working on customer-facing data integrations such as HRIS or payroll feeds via SFTP and in EDI format

  • Experience with MCP server development, or different ways of preparing data for AI agents such as ontology modelling, context, knowledge graphs, and semantic layers.

We don't expect all of it. We do expect curiosity about it.

Why join us?

Ben's customers are large enterprise employers, and the hundreds of thousands of people who work for them rely on us to get their benefits right, every time. That depends on data moving accurately between their systems and ours, every cycle. You get to work on the data infrastructure that makes this run like clockwork.

At the same time, Ben is an AI-native organisation. Agents are already doing a lot of impactful work here, and they can only do it on data they can trust. That raises questions a dashboard never had to answer. How fresh does this need to be for an agent to act on it? How do you match the same entity across tools? How do you control what an agent is allowed to see? Very few engineers have answered those in production. You'd be one of them.

You'll take ownership of large, complex problem spaces, help design how they scale, and build an agentic layer few engineers have built anywhere yet, and you'll see the impact of it: Ben supports hundreds of thousands of people across 30+ countries.

Our Compensation & Benefits

It's important to us to practise what we preach when it comes to benefits. We know what good looks like and we want to provide the best for our team, with a comprehensive and inclusive benefits package. You'll have a choice over the things that are most important to you. You can see a selection below, with the full offering here.

💰 Competitive base salary + equity, so you own what you build

⭐ Bonus scheme designed to reward and recognise high performance

💳 £100 monthly personal Ben Balance: for whatever works for you, whether that's Netflix, Spotify, or a really expensive cup of coffee! This allowance will increase by £50 for each year of service until you reach £250

🍔 Weekly lunch provided in office so you can spend quality time with the team over some tasty food!

🏖 28 days of holidays a year plus bank holidays, and an option to buy or sell 5 days per year. Your holiday entitlement increases to 30 days at your 3rd year of service!

🌴 Work-from-abroad scheme, so you can support your travels, enjoy an extended holiday, or visit loved ones.

🍼 Enhanced parental leave and workplace nursery scheme to support with the cost of childcare in a nursery setting

❤️ Comprehensive Private Medical Insurance

💌 Funded Life Assurance cover with the option to voluntarily increase. This also includes an annual health check

🧠 Comprehensive mental health support and professional coaching through a leading provider

 

Diversity and Culture at Ben

We are organically growing a brilliantly diverse, inclusive and respectful bunch of people we are extremely proud of. This should go without saying, but all applications are very much welcome. If you need any adjustments to support you with your application, just let us know by emailing Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow Engineering Full Time London

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer, AI Platform (Toqan)
jobs.description:
Senior Backend Engineer, AI Platform (Toqan)

Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

The Opportunity

Toqan is Prosus's internal AI platform — the infrastructure and tooling layer that powers agentic AI-driven products across the entire group.We are building secure, configurable agent runtimes that can operate reliably at scale across different products, channels and use cases..  

You’ll work where distributed systems meet applied AI: orchestrating models and tools, enabling agents to perform long-running work, and turning rapidly evolving AI capabilities into dependable platform primitives. The challenges span asynchronous workflows, isolated execution, extensible integrations, reliability, observability and cost control.

The Toqan platform serves the whole Prosus portfolio and other connected businesses, which means the backend systems you build here have reach far beyond a single team. You'll join a 12-person engineering team in Amsterdam and work closely with product, platform and AI colleagues to ship end-to-end — at pace, without compromising quality.

Who You Are

You are a senior backend engineer who has moved well past following patterns and into setting them. You're comfortable owning architectural decisions on novel infrastructure — the kind where the right answer isn't obvious and the stakes are real. You think in systems, spot failure modes early, and hold a high bar for production quality without letting perfect block good. The 80/20 mindset comes naturally: you know when to go deep and when to ship.

You've likely come from a startup or high-velocity environment where shipping fast wasn't a culture slogan — it was survival. You know how to cut scope without cutting corners, move from zero to production without a safety net, and iterate quickly on systems that are still finding their shape.

You're genuinely curious about the AI and LLM space — not as a trend to track, but as a domain where you've already done hands-on integration work and want to go further. AI tools aren't an afterthought in how you work — you use them daily, whether that's Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or OpenAI Codex, and you've developed real judgment about where they accelerate work and where they don't. You operate with low ego, share context freely, and thrive in an environment where autonomy and accountability go hand in hand. Ambiguity doesn't slow you down — it's where you do your best work.

What You Bring

  • Strong Go programming skills with a track record of building and operating production backend services

  • Hands-on AWS experience — designing, deploying, and operating cloud-native services at scale

  • Experience integrating LLMs, AI models or tool-calling systems into production applications

  • Familiarity with agentic architectures and protocols such as MCP, A2A

  • A systems mindset, with attention to reliability, scalability, performance and security

  • Experience with CI/CD, automated testing and production observability

  • A record of working across product and platform teams to deliver outcomes end-to-end

  • Regular, thoughtful use of AI coding tools as part of your development workflow

Nice to haves

  • Hands-on experience building agentic AI systems that use tools and execute multi-step workflows

  • Experience building or maintaining event-sourced systems

  • Python programming skills

  • Experience with AI or ML infrastructure and developer productivity tooling

Your Typical Day

No two days look exactly the same. You might design a new capability for the agent runtime, improve how models and tools are orchestrated, investigate a production reliability issue, or take an integration from an early prototype to a secure, observable service.

You’ll spend much of your time building in Go, reviewing code and making architectural decisions with the team. You’ll also work closely with product, platform and AI colleagues to shape requirements, test ideas and ship them safely. Along the way, you’ll improve the testing, deployment and observability foundations that let the team move quickly with confidence.

What We Offer

  • Global Impact: Play a crucial role in shaping the future of global commerce.

  • Growth Opportunities: Expand your expertise through diverse global challenges and unique opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Join a forward-thinking team that values strategic insights and fosters continuous innovation.

  • Creative Environment: Engage in work that encourages creativity and constant improvement.

jobs.description:
Quantum Applications Engineer

Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include very energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Description of the Project

As a Quantum Applications Engineer, you will work at the intersection of quantum algorithms, real-world applications and customer projects.

Your mission will be to identify relevant problems that can be addressed using Quandela's quantum computing technology, assess their feasibility and define how meaningful performance should be measured.

Working directly with industrial and academic partners, you will translate real-world challenges into quantum computing problems, evaluate potential approaches and establish the appropriate benchmarks against classical methods.

This is a highly technical role with strong exposure to customers and partners. It is particularly suited to someone with a background in quantum algorithms who wants to apply that expertise to practical use cases rather than focus exclusively on theoretical research.

Your Key Responsibilities

    • Identify and assess quantum use cases by working with customers, industrial partners and internal teams to understand their challenges and translate them into relevant computational problems.
    • Perform feasibility studies to determine whether and how these problems can be addressed using current and near-term quantum computing technologies, with a particular focus on NISQ approaches.
    • Define meaningful benchmarks, including relevant problem instances, expected outputs, accuracy targets and classical baselines to objectively evaluate quantum approaches.
    • Explore promising application domains and contribute to application roadmaps, from near-term demonstrations to longer-term utility-scale applications.
    • Evaluate scientific, industrial and economic value to help prioritize the applications where quantum computing can have the greatest impact.
    • Design and maintain strategic demonstrations and Proofs of Concept, working with internal teams or external software partners depending on the project.
    • Follow customer projects throughout their lifecycle, including projects where algorithm development is performed by external partners.
    • Present technical work to customers and partners, explaining quantum approaches, results, limitations and opportunities to both technical and non-specialist audiences.
    • Collaborate closely with Quandela's algorithm, machine learning, product, project management, sales and engineering teams.

Depending on the strategic interest of a project, you may also contribute directly to the development and implementation of quantum algorithms in Python.

What will make you successful

You do not need to know every possible quantum application from day one.

What matters is your ability to approach an unfamiliar problem, ask the right questions, understand its computational structure and determine whether quantum computing provides an interesting direction to explore.

You are comfortable navigating between research and practical applications: scientifically rigorous enough to challenge an algorithmic approach, pragmatic enough to assess its real-world relevance, and comfortable enough with people to discuss your conclusions directly with customers.

Requirements

You have a strong technical background in quantum computing and quantum algorithms, combined with the curiosity and communication skills required to explore real-world applications.

You ideally bring:

  • A PhD in quantum computing, quantum information, physics, applied mathematics, computer science or a related field, or a Master's degree combined with relevant professional experience.
  • A first professional experience in a similar environment is strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of quantum algorithms, particularly approaches applicable to current or near-term quantum computers.
  • Knowledge of NISQ algorithms and variational quantum algorithms.
  • Good programming skills, particularly in Python.
  • The ability to understand a complex industrial or scientific problem and translate it into a computational and algorithmic framework.
  • A rigorous approach to benchmarking quantum and classical methods.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and the confidence to present technical topics directly to customers, partners and broader audiences.
  • Professional proficiency in English.

Previous experience working on customer-facing technical projects, quantum application projects, consulting, pre-sales, collaborative R&D projects or industrial partnerships would be a strong plus.

Experience with Agile ways of working and tools such as Jira is appreciated but not essential.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer:

  • A role at the intersection of cutting-edge quantum research and real-world industrial applications.
  • Direct exposure to a wide variety of quantum computing use cases and industries.
  • The opportunity to work with leading researchers, engineers, industrial partners and customers.
  • Significant ownership in shaping Quandela's application portfolio and identifying the problems quantum computing should address next.
  • The opportunity to work across the full quantum stack, from algorithms and software to Quandela's photonic quantum computing technology.
  • A hybrid work model (3-4 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris or 1 to 2 days remotely).

Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview (30' - 45')
  • Hiring Managers Interview (45')
  • Use Case (a live use case or one to be prepared at home and presented afterward)
  • Meeting with the teams
  • 2 to 3 reference check
  • Offer

(This process is provided for guidance only and may evolve depending on the roles)

At Quandela, we believe that the strength of our team is the plurality of experiences, perspectives, and journeys. We are committed to building a respectful, inclusive, and welcoming work environment. All applications are welcome.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Billing & Monetization
jobs.description:
Engineering Manager, Billing & Monetization

About the role

Every customer's path through DataSnipper, from first sign-up to first agent run to renewal, runs on systems your team owns. We are hiring an Engineering Manager in our Amsterdam office to lead Billing & Monetization: how customers get in, what they are entitled to, and how AI usage turns into revenue.

Why DataSnipper?

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empowers those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.


For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output must be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand-new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

The Scope

  • Onboarding & offboarding: sign-up, trials, tenant and workspace provisioning, and the first-run experience. Getting a new firm from contract to value, fast.

  • Licensing & entitlements: seats, plans, feature access and limits across the Excel add-in and Alwin, for self-serve users and global enterprise contracts alike.

  • Metering & billing: real-time usage and credit consumption for our agentic products, through to invoicing, payments and revenue reporting.

What You Will Do

  • Lead through outcomes, not tasks. Set clear goals and trust the team to find the how.

  • Make the team measurably better. Raise the bar, grow engineers into bigger problems, and address performance directly.

  • Own the technical direction of the full customer lifecycle platform, and stay close enough to the code to make the hard calls credibly.

  • Build systems where correctness is non-negotiable: accurate metering, enforced entitlements, reliable billing, all observable, secure and auditable.

  • Treat onboarding as a product. Measure activation and time-to-value, and remove friction with Product and Design.

  • Continuously improve on the admin experience to delight and empower our internal users.

  • Turn commercial strategy into software. Partner with Product, Finance, Sales and Customer Success to shape pricing, packaging and licensing models.

  • Set the bar for AI-assisted engineering. Not just shipping faster, but taking on harder problems, and shaping how DataSnipper engineering uses AI.

  • Grow the scope. Expand ownership and stand up new teams as the area grows.

What You Bring

  • 3+ years leading engineering teams, on top of 5+ years as a software engineer

  • An empowerment style of leadership and a track record of building high-performing teams

  • Experience building billing, licensing, entitlement or onboarding systems at scale, ideally usage- or credit-based

  • Strong fundamentals in software architecture, distributed systems, APIs and cloud-native development

  • Experience running production systems where financial correctness matters

  • Strong product aptitude: you challenge framing, make roadmap trade-offs, and care about activation and conversion as much as uptime

  • Hands-on fluency with AI coding tools and agentic harnesses, and a team that is measurably better for using them

  • A strategic, entrepreneurial mindset: you shape direction, not just execute it

Nice to Have

What We Offer

jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager Transport (Equipment)

About us

Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 100+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next!

Mission of this role

Getting equipment to and from an event, on time and in one piece, is one of the most critical things our customers do, and one of the hardest. Heavy, specialised, often fragile gear. Fixed vehicle and crew capacity. Round trips rather than one-way drops. Our customers solve this every week, mostly with spreadsheets, phone calls and hard-won instinct.

Transport is a priority on our roadmap, and we're bringing in dedicated ownership to make sure we deliver on it: how customers plan loads, sequence stops and optimise routes across their fleet. This role owns that outcome from the ground up. You'll start by getting close to customers to find the first slice of the problem they'll genuinely want to have solved, ship it, and build the roadmap from there.

Which features ship is yours to decide. You'll be shaping the domain and its roadmap, with the freedom to define how the product takes form. That's a rare amount of ownership for a PM, building something new from first principles, with real trust in how you get there.

What you'll do

  • Own Transport end to end: Running the full release train for your value stream: discovery, scoping, design, development, launch and post-launch tracking.

  • Run customer discovery yourself, in the field: Talk to rental companies about how they plan, staff and execute transport today: warehouse-to-venue routing, multi-stop and multi-vehicle loads, load order, crew and vehicle capacity, and the constraints that make equipment transport harder than generic delivery routing.

  • Define the first sellable increment. Find the smallest thing customers will genuinely pay for, ship it, and be able to explain why that slice was the right first bet.

  • Build and own a sequenced, evidence-based roadmap with the Head of Product, aligned to company goals and product strategy. And explain the prioritisation to sales, support and management so they can plan against it.

  • Translate routing and logistics complexity into buildable scope: multi-stop optimisation, time windows, vehicle and crew capacity, mapping and routing APIs, and the build-vs-buy decisions that come with them.

  • Define success before you build it: Every feature carries a business goal, product briefs stay current, a live dashboard goes up at launch, and you drive go-to-market together with Product Marketing, Support, Sales and Content & Community.

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years as a Product Manager in B2B SaaS.

  • You've owned a product area end to end. From discovery through launch and post-launch tracking, not a backlog-only PO role.

  • You're comfortable with operationally complex problems: routing, scheduling, fleet or capacity planning, supply chain, field service. A logistics background is a plus, not a must.

  • You work from data. You can show how you set a success metric, what you did when it was missed, and how you make the business case behind a product call.

  • You've run customer discovery yourself, not through a research team, and you can make and defend scope calls on partial evidence.

Nice to haves

  • Product experience in route optimisation, fleet management, field service or supply chain / TMS, or hands-on experience with mapping and routing APIs and platforms (Google Maps Platform, HERE, Mapbox, route-optimisation engines).

  • Experience building a product domain or team from scratch (0-to-1), not only taking one over.

  • Experience in the live event, AV or equipment rental industry, and/or Dutch, German or French.

What you’ll get

  • Competitive salary based on experience, plus 8% holiday allowance

  • A results-based bonus based on company performance (up to a full 13th month's salary)

  • 25 vacation days to recharge

  • Earn an extra day of PTO for each year at Rentman, from your second anniversary up to five years.

  • A 4-week paid sabbatical after 5 years to go on an adventure

  • Flexible WFH policy & work from anywhere for 4 weeks a year

  • Pension plan through BrightPensioen

  • An annual training budget to grow your skills

  • Your choice of a shiny new Windows, Linux, or Mac

  • An OV Business card if you live more than 10km from the office

  • An ambitious, inclusive, and diverse international team

  • A flexible, energizing workplace with free lunches, office perks (PS5, ping pong, D&D), legendary karaoke nights, and regular team activities

jobs.title: Director, Partner Programs, Enablement, and Operations
jobs.description:
Director, Partner Programs, Enablement, and Operations

About Ping Identity:

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

Role overview

Ping Identity is seeking a strategic, highly execution-oriented Director, Partner Programs, Enablement & Operations to build the operating system that helps our partners create pipeline, win business, and deliver customer outcomes.

This role brings together three connected disciplines: partner program design, partner enablement, and chief-of-staff-style operating leadership. You will translate channel strategy into repeatable programs, equip partners and internal teams to execute, and establish the planning, measurement, and decision cadence required to scale our partner business.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable designing a global partner program, facilitating an executive decision, building a practical enablement journey, and turning an ambiguous cross-functional priority into a clear plan with owners, milestones, and measurable outcomes.

What you will do

Build and evolve the partner programs portfolio

  • Design and manage a coherent partner-program framework spanning recruitment, onboarding, activation, specialization, co-selling, services readiness, incentives, recognition, and lifecycle management.
  • Establish transparent principles for partner segmentation, prioritization, investment, access to strategic initiatives, and progression through the partner lifecycle.
  • Create program requirements, benefits, governance, operating guidelines, and communications that are simple for field teams and partners to understand and use.
  • Develop repeatable frameworks for joint business planning, partner commitments, mutual action plans, strategic partner agreements, and measurable outcomes.
  • Partner with Legal, Finance, Product, Marketing, Sales, Services, and Operations to ensure programs are scalable, economically sound, and aligned to company priorities.

Lead partner enablement and activation

  • Define the minimum partner-ready package for priority products and motions, including messaging, use cases, demos, pricing and SKU guidance, sales plays, presales support, delivery readiness, and customer proof.
  • Build role-based enablement journeys for partner executives, sellers, solution architects, consultants, delivery teams, and customer-success stakeholders.
  • Establish a practical calendar of onboarding, training, certification, launch, and reinforcement activities tied to partner and business outcomes.
  • Create the feedback loop that continuously improves enablement content based on partner adoption, field usage, win/loss evidence, and customer results.
  • Coordinate with Revenue Enablement, Product, Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Experience, Marketing, and regional alliances leaders to eliminate duplication and close readiness gaps.
  • Champion fast, iterative delivery: put useful assets in partners’ hands early, measure usage and impact, and improve them based on evidence.

Operate as a chief-of-staff for the partner organization

  • Establish the partner organization’s operating cadence, including annual and quarterly planning, weekly execution reviews, pipeline and forecast inspection, executive readouts, and action follow-through.
  • Convert strategic priorities into integrated plans with clear owners, milestones, dependencies, decisions, and escalation paths.
  • Prepare leadership meetings, QBRs, business reviews, and executive partner engagements with concise narratives, decision materials, and recommended actions.
  • Maintain a single view of strategic initiatives, partner commitments, risks, cross-functional dependencies, and overdue or blocked actions.
  • Build dashboards and operating metrics that connect partner activity to pipeline, sourced and influenced revenue, activation, enablement adoption, delivery readiness, customer outcomes, and return on investment.
  • Improve clarity around partner attribution, field rules of engagement, investment decisions, incentives, and the handoffs between direct sales and partners.
  • Surface trade-offs early, drive decisions to closure, and ensure commitments are translated into accountable execution.

Drive executive and cross-functional alignment

  • Serve as a trusted advisor and connective tissue across Channel Alliances, Sales, Marketing, Product, Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Experience, Finance, Legal, and Revenue Operations.
  • Build productive relationships with partner executives and internal leaders, earning credibility through sound judgment, responsiveness, and delivery.
  • Facilitate complex decisions where priorities, resources, or ownership are unclear.
  • Support strategic partner motions, including executive alignment, joint go-to-market planning, customer engagement, and mutual investment discussions.
  • Provide clear, data-informed recommendations to senior leadership on partner priorities, programs, enablement investments, and operating model improvements.

Build the capability and culture

  • Lead through influence across a distributed, global organization and build a high-accountability, partner-first culture.
  • Develop program, enablement, and operations capabilities through hiring, coaching, clear role design, reusable processes, and strong cross-functional partnerships.
  • Establish standards for high-quality planning, communication, measurement, and follow-through.

What success looks like

In the first 12 months, you will:

  • Launch a clear partner-program and enablement operating model with defined ownership, governance, milestones, and success measures.
  • Establish a prioritized partner portfolio and transparent criteria for investment, access, activation, and progression.
  • Deliver a measurable enablement plan for priority products and partner motions, with adoption and business-impact reporting.
  • Improve the quality and consistency of partner pipeline inspection, attribution, forecasting, and executive reporting.
  • Create a dependable operating cadence that closes decisions, exposes risks early, and improves cross-functional execution.
  • Demonstrate stronger partner engagement, field adoption, and measurable contribution to pipeline, revenue, and customer outcomes.

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Approximately 9–11 years of experience in partner programs, channel strategy, alliances, revenue operations, sales enablement, business operations, or a related discipline.
  • Experience in a software, cloud, cybersecurity, identity, or other technology ecosystem with complex partner motions.
  • Demonstrated success designing and scaling partner programs, enablement programs, or cross-functional operating models.
  • Strong program-management and operating-rhythm skills, including planning, prioritization, dependency management, metrics, and executive communication.
  • Ability to move between strategy and execution: define the model, make the plan, align stakeholders, and drive delivery.
  • Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, influencing, and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong business judgment and comfort making recommendations with incomplete information.
  • Experience working across Sales, Marketing, Product, Services, Finance, Legal, and Operations.
  • High ownership, follow-through, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a rapidly changing environment.
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as needed.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with global system integrators, regional system integrators, distributors, resellers, cloud marketplaces, or technology partners.
  • Experience building partner tiering, specialization, incentives, investment, onboarding, certification, or co-selling programs.
  • Experience translating product launches into partner-ready go-to-market and delivery motions.
  • Experience running executive operating cadences, QBRs, leadership reviews, or chief-of-staff/business-operations functions.
  • Familiarity with CRM, partner relationship management, analytics, planning, and collaboration tools.
  • Experience in identity and access management, cybersecurity, SaaS, or enterprise infrastructure.
  • MBA or other relevant advanced degree.

Base Hiring Range: $149,000 - $173,000

In accordance with Colorado’s Equal Pay for Equal Work Act (SB 19-085) the approximate compensation range for this role in Colorado is listed above. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors, such as knowledge, skills, and abilities.

Life at Ping:

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day.

Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:

  • A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.
  • Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.
  • Regular company and team bonding events.
  • Competitive benefits and perks.
  • Global volunteering and community initiatives

Our Benefits:

  • Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule
  • Parental Leave
  • Progressive Healthcare Options
  • Retirement Programs
  • Opportunity for Education Reimbursement
  • Commuter Offset (Specific locations)

Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone’s individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self.

We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Engineering Manager

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a Product Engineering team in our Automation Domain in Berlin.

The Automation Domain is responsible for building and owning Nelly’s SaaS and AI products - everything from onboarding new medical practices, the Doctor, Patient, and Back Office portals, to automating bureaucracy and practice workflows, and the AI Scribe, Billing Agent, and Treatment Plan generation products.

The role

You'll lead a fast moving AI enabled team that is building a new, but central, product. You’ll ensure the team is able to explore, experiment, and iterate quickly - testing new features and ideas internally and with our customers.

The product is new, giving you the opportunity to define the product with the team based on experimentation. The team needs to learn fast and be able to let go of ideas that don’t work. You’ll guide the team through this process, striving to improve how the team operates and enabling it to move faster.

The team is growing quickly, giving you an opportunity and responsibility to hiring a high performing team and define how it operates.

About Nelly

We are building the AI-Driven Financial Operating System for European healthcare, solving the biggest challenges for patients and practices. We create what no bank or software platform can handle. Our all-in-one platform transforms chaotic administrative processes into intelligent, automated workflows, from patient care to billing to next-generation payments. Because we truly believe: healthcare should be less about paperwork and more about people.

Why? Because Europe is facing a massive shortage of medical professionals. And if we don't rethink the way practices work, the system won't be able to keep up. With our Series B funding of over €50 million from world-class investors, we are turning our vision into reality.

What sets us apart: We work with the best team, which is why we give everything together every day. We believe in Talent Density, because exceptional people make everyone around them better. At Nelly, we move fast and expect everyone to keep up. Stagnation isn’t an option, which is why we invest heavily in growth. AI is an essential part of how we work at Nelly. We expect you to use it every day and give you everything you need to do so. You get trust and ownership and we expect you to speak up, even when it's uncomfortable.

What you'll do

  • Lead, inspire and grow a high-performing team of 3–6 software and AI engineers.

  • Collaborate closely with a product manager to iteratively build, launch, and improve new products

  • Own hiring for your team, building a team of high performing engineers.

  • Keep your team at the cutting edge of LLM and AI based engineering, testing new ideas and tech as it’s released

  • Own the quality, reliability, and security of your team’s products. Delivering high availability production systems

  • Stay hands on, developing with your team

  • Contribute to engineering-wide initiatives as a member of Nelly’s engineering leadership team

What we're looking for

  • 1+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager and 8+ years of overall experience in software development

  • A strong technical background, building customer facing products

  • Experience working in the TypeScript or similar ecosystems and a drive to proactively learn both.

  • Experience with cloud native development.

  • Experience designing, building, and owning customer facing products and production back-end systems

  • A deep understanding of software engineering processes and team management

  • Empathy and excellent communication skills

What we offer:

  • The people you get to work with. You will work alongside the brightest minds we could find, on hard problems, as a team. We take on challenges together and we never forget to have fun doing it.

  • Room to grow faster than almost anywhere else. New challenges, more scope, real ownership from day one. We trust you to own it and to speak up when something is wrong. Just do not expect to stand still.

  • A yearly learning and development budget, plus the coaching, feedback and internal knowledge that actually move you forward. Real investment in your learning.

  • A front row seat while we build something big. We are building the financial operating system for European healthcare, with AI woven into how we build, sell and support. Real scope, real impact.

  • Deutschlandticket or Swapfiets membership.

  • Urban Sports Club membership.

  • Flexible working hours and a hybrid setup and up to 4 weeks of workation.

  • A dog friendly office.

We welcome applications from people of all genders and backgrounds, regardless of origin or age. If you're convinced you're the right fit for this role - even if your CV doesn't match the requirements 100% - tell us why.
