jobs.description:
Account Executive, Strategic (EMEA)

About Docker

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

The Account Executive, Strategic, is responsible for managing and expanding relationships with key strategic accounts. This role involves a deep understanding of the client's business, the ability to develop strategic plans to increase revenue, and ensuring client satisfaction through excellent service. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in sales, exceptional communication skills, and the ability to navigate complex negotiations.

Responsibilities

  • Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships with strategic clients. Act as the main point of contact and advocate for client needs within the company.

  • Strategic Business Planning: Develop a thorough understanding of key client needs and requirements. Work closely with clients to devise and implement strategic plans that align with their business goals and drive mutual growth.

  • Sales Targets: Achieve and exceed sales quotas within assigned portfolio by identifying and closing business opportunities.

  • Market Analysis: Conduct research and analysis to understand industry trends, competitive landscape, and client feedback to inform strategic planning and identify new business opportunities.

  • Collaboration: with cross-functional teams (including marketing, product development, and customer service) to ensure a cohesive and comprehensive approach to market.

  • Reporting and Forecasting: Provide accurate forecasts and track key account metrics. Report on the status of accounts and transactions, and monitor sales performance against goals.

  • Contract Negotiation: Lead contract negotiations, ensuring favorable terms for both the client and the company.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years experience selling to large, complex F100 businesses, demonstrating a successful track record of meeting or exceeding targets, preferably in a similar industry or role.

  • Demonstrated ability to communicate, present, and influence credibly and effectively at all levels of the organization, including executive and C-level.

  • Experience delivering client-focused solutions to customer needs.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple account management projects at a time while maintaining sharp attention to detail.

  • Excellent listening, negotiation, and presentation abilities.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.

  • Above and beyond: Trained in Command of the Message and MEDDPICC

What to expect

First 30 days:

  • Understanding the Company and Product: Gain a deep understanding of the company's products or services, value proposition, and the competitive landscape. This includes completing all necessary onboarding training and familiarizing oneself with the company culture and processes.

  • Relationship Building: Begin to establish relationships with key internal stakeholders, including sales, marketing, product, and customer support teams. Understanding their roles and how they can contribute to the success of strategic accounts is crucial.

  • Client Familiarization: Start to get acquainted with the portfolio of strategic accounts, including reviewing account histories, previous interactions, and current contracts or agreements. Initial meetings with some key clients may also take place to introduce yourself as their new point of contact.

First 90 Days:

  • Strategic Planning: Develop detailed strategic plans for each key account, identifying opportunities for growth, potential challenges, and strategic objectives. This should be done in collaboration with clients and internal teams.

  • Performance Metrics: Establish clear KPIs for success within your accounts, aligned with both client expectations and company goals. Begin tracking these metrics closely.

  • Sales and Negotiations: Start actively pursuing new business opportunities within strategic accounts, which may involve negotiating terms for contracts or renewals. Efforts to cross-sell or up-sell should also be underway.

  • Feedback Loop: Implement a process for regularly gathering and acting on client feedback to improve service delivery and client satisfaction.

One Year Outlook:

  • Achieving Sales Targets: By the one-year mark, you should have met or exceeded the initial sales targets set for your strategic accounts. This includes successfully closing new deals and expanding business within existing accounts.

  • Strategic Account Growth: Demonstrated growth in strategic accounts through increased engagement, higher revenue, and enhanced partnership levels. Your strategic planning and execution should result in tangible benefits for both the clients and your company.

  • Relationship Depth: At this point, you should have established deep, trust-based relationships with key stakeholders within each strategic account. You're seen as a strategic advisor rather than just a sales contact.

  • Process Improvements: Identification and implementation of process improvements based on lessons learned over the year to increase efficiency, customer satisfaction, and sales effectiveness.

  • Professional Development: Continued professional growth, possibly including leadership development, advanced sales strategies, and industry knowledge enhancement to better serve strategic accounts and contribute to the company's objectives.

Success in an Account Executive Strategic role is measured not just by sales figures but by the depth of relationships built, the strategic value delivered to clients, and the positive impact on the company’s long-term growth. Regular reviews against these expectations can help in identifying areas for improvement and adjusting strategies as necessary.

Docker does not offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Compensation & Equity

EU: €183,400K – €262K OTE + equity

______________________________________________________________________

Posting Information

  • Open vacancy: This posting is for an existing open role.

  • AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.

  • Interview recordings: Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent.

______________________________________________________________________

Perks & Benefits

  • Remote-first by design – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration.

  • Flexibility that fits your life – We trust you to manage your schedule while delivering great work.

  • Time to recharge – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break.

  • Home office support – Set up your workspace for comfort and success.

  • Technology stipend – Equivalent to US$100 net per month to help support your work.

  • Learning & development – Annual stipend for conferences, courses, certifications, and continued learning.

  • Parental leave – 16 weeks of paid parental leave after six months of employment.

  • Equity for all full-time employees – Share in Docker's long-term success as we continue to grow.

  • Comprehensive benefits – Medical, retirement, and paid holidays vary by country.

  • Docker swag – Because representing the whale never gets old.

Docker is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe diverse teams build better products, make better decisions, and better serve our global community.

jobs.title: Deployment Manager
jobs.description:
Deployment Manager

At Hive, we're building the defining physical AI platform of the next decade.

Industrial labor is one of the most acute bottlenecks in the global economy. Operators are expensive, hard to retain, and working in environments that are increasingly unsafe. The shortage is structural. The window to solve it is now.

Our answer is a machine-agnostic intelligence platform that lets any machine, on any site, perceive, decide, and act autonomously. One platform. Any machine. No fleet replacement.

Already live across multiple sites and customers in Europe - spanning logistics and warehousing, industrial manufacturing, and large-scale chemical production - with a US expansion underway.

The vision: one operator managing hundreds of machines simultaneously. Productive machine-hour cost dropping by 80x, and unlocks the next productivity revolution in physical work.

The mission is to make productivity limitless. Come and help us build it.

 

The Role

As Deployment Manager, you will own the end-to-end delivery of customer deployments in the UK, from delivery kickoff through commissioning, validation, go-live and operational handover.

You will coordinate customers, engineering teams, operators, equipment, logistics, site readiness and technical dependencies into one executable plan. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role with significant time spent at industrial sites.

As one of Hive's first deployment managers in the UK, you will also help define how we deploy at scale across the country.

 
 

What You Will Do

 

Own Customer Deployments End-to-End

  • Own UK customer projects from delivery kickoff through successful operational handover.

  • Build and maintain the integrated deployment plan across people, machines, hardware, software, logistics, site readiness, safety and customer dependencies.

  • Establish clear milestones, owners, dependencies and acceptance criteria.

  • Drive execution and escalate risks before they become delivery problems.

  • Ensure deployments are delivered safely, on time and to the expected quality.

Lead Site Readiness and Deployment

  • Work directly with customers to prepare sites for deployment and go-live.

  • Coordinate infrastructure, connectivity, machines, operating areas, safety requirements and operational procedures.

  • Lead on-site deployment activities together with Hive Engineering and Operations.

  • Coordinate installation, commissioning, testing, validation and acceptance activities.

Be the Customer's Delivery Owner

  • Act as the primary delivery counterpart for the customer.

  • Maintain clear communication on progress, risks, decisions and dependencies.

  • Coordinate customer stakeholders across operations, engineering, IT, HSE and management.

  • Build trust through strong execution, ownership and transparency.

Coordinate Cross-Functional Execution

  • Work closely with Engineering, Product, QA and Operations.

  • Translate customer and site requirements into clear internal actions.

  • Coordinate technical resources during deployment and drive issues to resolution.

  • Balance customer urgency with safety, quality and technical readiness.

Build the UK Deployment Playbook

  • Develop repeatable deployment processes, templates and checklists.

  • Capture lessons learned and continuously improve how Hive deploys.

  • Help define the local capabilities, suppliers, facilities and resources required as the UK business scales.

 

What We're Looking For

 

Essential

  • Strong experience delivering complex projects in industrial, field or customer environments.

  • Proven end-to-end ownership of deployments, implementations, commissioning or operational projects.

  • Excellent planning, coordination and execution skills.

  • Comfortable coordinating technical teams and non-technical customer stakeholders.

  • Strong customer-facing communication and stakeholder management.

  • Hands-on mentality and ability to operate effectively when priorities change quickly.

  • Strong safety mindset.

  • Willingness to travel extensively across the UK.

  • Professional fluency in English and authorization to work in the UK.

 

Strongly preferred

  • Experience from industrial automation, robotics, autonomous systems, heavy equipment, material handling, warehousing, logistics, mining, construction, manufacturing, field engineering or field service.

  • Experience working directly with industrial equipment or operational technology.

 

What success looks like

  • Hive's first UK customer deployments are delivered safely and successfully.

  • Customers have clear ownership and confidence in Hive's execution.

  • Deployment risks and dependencies are identified early and actively managed.

  • Operations receives a stable, documented and operationally ready service at handover.

  • Hive develops a repeatable UK deployment methodology that improves with every customer.

Why Join Hive?

Join Hive at a pivotal stage as we expand into the UK and build a new category in Physical AI. You’ll work with cutting-edge autonomy technology and a highly experienced team to bring autonomous industrial machines out of development and into real-world commercial operations.

As we establish and scale our UK operations, you’ll have the opportunity to take on significant responsibility from day one, help shape how we operate in the UK, and build the playbooks for deploying and operating autonomous machines at scale..

 

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Early applications are encouraged. Hive values diversity and encourages qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation or background.

Team Lead Manager - Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Team Lead Manager - Product Engineer

Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for highly technical engineers who want to lead and manage one of our engineering teams. It took over 10,000 interviews to hire our first 50 Omneans, and we’re now growing from 11 to more than 14 engineering teams in the coming months. Over the next year, our engineering team will double in size, our enterprise customer base will grow from ~180 to 300+, and revenue will triple.

 

As a Team Lead Manager, you’ll lead a small team of engineers. You’ll set its technical direction, line-manage and grow the people in it, and stay hands-on in the code. This is not a hands-off management role: our teams are small, and you’ll be one of the strongest engineers on yours. You’ll partner closely with a Product Manager and Product Designer to decide what to build, and you’ll be accountable for how well it’s built and how fast it ships.

 

If you’re a strong Tech Lead who hasn’t managed people yet, we’d still love to hear from you. You can start as a Team Lead, with management handled by an Engineering Manager, and grow into the full role with our support.

 

What Can You Expect As a Team Lead Manager?

  • Lead and Manage a Small Team. Line-manage the engineers on your team, run 1:1s, give feedback, and help them take on bigger problems.

  • Stay Deeply Technical. You’ll still build. Expect to spend a meaningful share of your time writing code, reviewing PRs, and unblocking the hardest technical problems.

  • AI-Native Development. AI is core to how we build. Engineers use Claude, Code, and agentic workflows every day, and our product is built on AI agents that automate complex procurement workflows. You’ll set the bar for how your team uses them.

  • Customers at the Center. Talk directly with customers to understand their problems, and make sure your team builds things that create real value for them.

  • Own Technical Direction. Make the architecture and design calls for your team’s problem space, and own the trade-offs between speed, quality, and long-term maintainability.

  • Work with Modern Technology. TypeScript across the stack, React, Postgres, and AWS serverless (Lambda, DynamoDB, EventBridge), managed through Pulumi and deployed via GitHub Actions. Datadog, Meticulous, and Incident.io round it out.

  • Shape the Roadmap. Work with your PM and Designer on prioritisation, scoping, and sequencing so the team ships what matters most.

  • Build the Team. Interview, hire, and onboard new engineers as we double in size.

 

About You

  • You’re a highly technical full-stack engineer. You’ve designed and shipped web apps end to end in TypeScript, ideally on AWS serverless, and you’re still one of the strongest engineers in the room.

  • You’ve led engineers. You’ve been a Tech Lead, Team Lead, or TLM, owning delivery and technical direction for a team.

  • You want to manage people, or grow into it. Ideally, you’ve line-managed engineers already. If not, you’re keen to learn.

  • You still love to build. Leading hasn’t pulled you away from the code, and you want a role where you keep shipping.

  • You raise the bar. You know what well-architected, reliable software looks like, and you help others get there through reviews, pairing, and clear feedback.

  • You’re motivated by customer impact. You care about outcomes for customers, not just output, and you make good calls on what to build and what to cut.

  • You’re a strong partner. You work well with product and design, push back when it matters, and bring people with you.

  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity. You can take an unclear problem, shape it, and get a team moving on it.

 

Nice-to-Haves

  • You’ve led a team through fast growth, ideally at a scale-up where the team and product changed quickly.

  • You’ve built B2B or enterprise SaaS, with complex workflows and demanding customers.

  • You’ve performed exceptionally at something else, be it academics, sport, or work.

 

Interview Process

Before applying, we strongly encourage you to spend a few minutes in our R&D Candidate Hub. It covers our engineering culture, ways of working, interview process, tech environment, and what it’s like to build at Omnea.

 

R&D Candidate Hub: https://omnea.notion.site/R-D-Candidate-Hub-2f688cce658780f1b942c81cd3a032d4

 

Note: our pair programming stage is in TypeScript OR Python and you’ll be assessed as if it’s your primary language. This is a full-stack, hands-on leadership role, so if you’re exclusively frontend, backend, or platform-focused, or no longer writing code, it likely isn’t the right fit.

 

The process generally includes:

 

  1. Initial screening call with our Talent team (30 mins, remote)

  2. AI Product Eng Challenge, language-agnostic (1 hour, remote)

  3. Onsite interviews at our Victoria office (~3 hours)

     

    • Engineering Culture interview with an Engineering Manager or Team Lead (45 mins)

    • System Design interview with a Senior Engineer (60 mins)

    • Engineering Leadership interview with our CTO (45 mins)

    • Office tour (15 mins)

 

We’re proud to support visa sponsorship for candidates who need it.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

Full Stack Engineer

About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.   

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection.   

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.  

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The opportunity: Full Stack Engineer

As a Full Stack Engineer, you will take primary ownership of our frontend experience while being capable of making the backend changes needed to unblock yourself and your team. You'll work closely with Backend Engineers, DevOps Engineers, and stakeholders to deliver scalable, reliable, and high-performance products end-to-end, from pixel to API.

Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates for this position who live within commuting distance of our office in Amsterdam.

What you'll do in this role

  • Design, develop, and maintain frontend components in Angular (and Lit HTML where applicable), ensuring optimal performance, responsiveness, and usability.

  • Own the integration layer between frontend and backend: consume and contribute to OpenAPI-defined APIs, handle data contracts, and wire up microservices cleanly.

  • Make targeted backend changes, new endpoints, tweaks to existing services, minor data model updates, so you can ship features without always depending on a dedicated backend engineer.

  • Contribute to architectural discussions across the full stack, from UI component structure to API design and data access patterns.

  • Participate actively in code reviews, providing feedback on both frontend and backend code quality, adherence to standards, and performance.

  • Mentor and support junior engineers across the stack.

  • Stay current with evolving frontend and full-stack best practices.

What you bring to the table

  • 3+ years of experience in frontend or full stack engineering.

  • Strong proficiency in Angular and experience with component-based frameworks such as Lit HTML.

  • Solid understanding of responsive design, UX/UI principles, and a keen eye for design detail.

  • Proven experience integrating with APIs and microservices, you understand HTTP, REST conventions, auth flows, and error handling deeply.

  • Working proficiency in Python, enough to navigate a FastAPI codebase, add or adjust endpoints, and write Pydantic models and SQLAlchemy queries.

  • Familiarity with relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL) at the query and schema level.

  • Experience with containerised workflows using Docker.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills; comfortable working independently and collaboratively.

  • Strong English communication skills and ability to work across disciplines.

  • Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as part of daily workflow.

  • Familiarity with LLM API integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) and an understanding of the UX patterns specific to AI-powered features.

What success in the first 6 months looks like

  • You've built trust with Backend, DevOps, and Product peers and taken clear ownership of 2–3 frontend domains, including their design system consistency and API integration contracts.

  • You've delivered frontend features end-to-end, from UX design discussion through Angular implementation, API wiring, tests, and documentation, without needing hand-holding at either layer.

  • You've unblocked yourself (and others) by making safe, well-reviewed backend changes: adding an endpoint, adjusting a response model, or optimising a query, rather than waiting in a queue.

  • You've raised frontend quality: responsive across devices, accessible, consistent with our design system, and validated against real API contracts rather than mocks.

  • You've contributed to meaningful observability on the frontend, error tracking, performance budgets, and linked them to backend SLIs where relevant.

  • You've shared knowledge through documentation, code reviews, and mentoring, so the team's frontend capability grows with you.

Current tech stack

We're fully cloud-native on AWS, with a lean, API-first product development approach.

Frontend: Angular · Lit HTML · Headless Wagtail · WordPress

Backend: Python · FastAPI · Pydantic · SQLAlchemy · MySQL · Neo4j

Platform: AWS · Kubernetes · Terraform · Docker · GitHub Actions · ruff · UV · pre-commit · Renovate

Our platform runs on Kubernetes-managed services and Terraform for infrastructure as code. We continue expanding capabilities in knowledge graphs (Neo4j) and modern data access patterns.

Equal opportunities

myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. Thoughtworks is seeking industry- and market-relevant business development professionals to join and lead a sector of our client growth in the Singapore region. As a Business Development Manager (BDM) you are responsible for prospecting, shaping and selling aspirational engagements for our clients as well as for Thoughtworks.

Your responsibilities and accountabilities include prospecting, identifying and qualifying new opportunities, building trust with potential clients, shaping deals, developing winning value propositions, tightly orchestrating sales pitches, proposals and orals, negotiating win / win agreements with prospective clients, and expanding follow-on sales to create a sustainable business within each account. You will work across client organizations, from C-level and board members to front line business and technical staff, building relationships to secure long-lasting business opportunities.

To be successful, you will have multiple years of consultative selling experience within an enterprise IT services company. Your experience should demonstrate industry relevance and expertise across one or more industry domains. You will have sold custom software application development and digital transformation services, and have demonstrated proficiency in prospecting, leading and securing custom software and digital transformation deals with significant total contract value (TCV). You will have expertise dealing with both business and IT leaders and executives.

Industry Expertise and Strategic Focus:

You will bring deep expertise, insights, and credibility in the key industry: Healthcare, Life Sciences and Public Sector

As a seasoned industry specialist, you have spent your career enabling clients to solve complex challenges and achieve meaningful business outcomes. You’ve cultivated trusted relationships across the C-suite and executive levels of key enterprises within your domain.

At Thoughtworks, you’ll use that industry-specific network and insight to articulate our differentiated value proposition, accelerate executive conversations, and drive new business opportunities. Your deep contextual understanding of the industry’s trends, challenges, and innovation priorities will position you to shape strategic solutions and drive meaningful client impact.

Job responsibilities

  • Develop relationships and leads with business and IT executives at target enterprise clients on an ongoing basis by leveraging your professional network, personal contacts and through creative networking, partnership and outbound selling strategies.
  • Execute on leads that may be generated through professional networks and industry events. Effectively position the full suite of Thoughtworks solutions and offerings to our clients, including offshore distribution of work effectively leveraging our global capabilities.
  • Consultative sales of product design, custom software, data and managed services by influencing and shaping customers' strategic decision making. This is accomplished through Thoughtworks value articulation and differentiated positioning with client executives, with a focus on generating longer term opportunities in excess of $10M in TCV.
  • Create and own the customer sales narrative, tightly orchestrate deal pursuits, manage and coordinate MSA, SOW and rate card negotiations, and shape complex consulting and software development agreements.
  • Stay ahead of industry trends, emerging technologies, and market shifts to position Thoughtworks effectively and act as a trusted advisor, helping senior client executives align technology investments with business goals.
  • Build and develop a robust sales pipeline, of ~3X qualified sales opportunity pipeline through leveraging direct sales , partnerships and referrals to meet and exceed sales and margin goals.
  • Work closely with delivery teams, solution architects, and marketing to tailor offerings to client needs.
  • Partner with alliances and ecosystem partners (e.g., AWS, Microsoft, Google Cloud) to drive joint sales opportunities.

Job qualifications

Technical Skills

  • Whilst this is a fully commercial role, Thoughtworks are a “technology at core” organisation. We have found that sales leaders who possess a deep understanding of the key aspects of agile and/or lean practices can often navigate our organisation ethos and goals for these lead roles more adeptly than traditional Commercial Managers or Sales Directors. With this in mind Thoughtworks are seeking a broad range of key skill sets to match the very interesting proposition we are working towards.

Professional Skills

  • Over ten years of applicable experience and a “hunter” mentality, with a proven track record that demonstrates superior lead prospecting, opportunity development, deal shaping, relationship building, negotiation, and commercial acumen within the digital transformation, custom application development and managed services market.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager
jobs.description:
Enterprise Account Manager

About Us:

Spreedly is the world's leading Open Payments Platform. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Durham, NC, the company gives mid-market and enterprise businesses the infrastructure to connect to any payment gateway, processor, or fraud tool through a single API. The platform is vendor-agnostic by design, meaning customers are never locked into a single provider and never need to rebuild their payments stack to access new capabilities.

The core business problem Spreedly solves is real and costly: global merchants face a fragmented payments ecosystem, where every new market, payment method, or fraud tool typically requires a separate, time-consuming integration. Spreedly eliminates that complexity, enabling companies to route transactions intelligently, secure cardholder data, prevent fraud, and expand into new markets without heavy engineering overhead.

About the Role:

As an Enterprise Account Manager at Spreedly, you’ll act as a strategic advisor and growth partner to a defined portfolio of high-value customers. You’ll own retention and expansion across complex accounts and build multi-threaded relationships that uncover value and strengthen customer commitment. This role requires curiosity and commercial discipline, blending relationship development with commercial execution. It requires the ability to manage both transactional details and strategic outcomes.

You will succeed by proactively aligning stakeholders, identifying opportunities for value improvement or acceleration, and guiding customers through Spreedly’s evolving platform. Your role will contribute to Spreedly’s growth by driving insights at the account level, expanding relationships with stakeholders, and ensuring that customers fully realize the benefits of our payments orchestration platform. Achieving success requires a thoughtful and consultative approach, along with the ability to support alignment across different functions. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in complex environments, enjoys solving customer challenges, and is energized by a culture of continuous learning and growth.

This is a US-based customer-facing role supporting primarily US customers and cross-functional teams operating within US business hours. Success in this role requires regular travel within the United States and the ability to work in alignment with US customer and internal stakeholder schedules.

Responsibilities:

  • Own a book of high-value customer accounts (~$3M+ in ARR)
  • Lead account planning and deliver quarterly business reviews with clear success metrics
  • Build strategic multi-threaded relationships across customer organizations
  • Conduct strategic account planning and maintain a proactive customer engagement cadence
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to unblock value and influence internal roadmap decisions
  • Accurately forecast retention, expansion, and potential risk within your portfolio
  • Analyze product usage and customer data to identify growth opportunities and risks
  • Drive execution on renewal and upsell strategies, including contract structuring
  • Provide market and customer insights to inform GTM evolution and segmentation strategy
  • Contribute to customer stories, reference programs, and pricing feedback loops
  • Leverage AI tools to enhance account planning, data analysis, and customer insights

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, or B2B SaaS Sales, with quota-carrying or expansion responsibilities
  • Background in payments, fintech, or infrastructure SaaS
  • Experience with consumption-based or API-first SaaS models
  • Proven track record managing $3M+ ARR with high retention and growth outcomes
  • Excellent communication, value-based selling, and stakeholder management skills
  • Operational discipline with systems like Salesforce, Clari, and account planning tools
  • Ability to independently manage multiple priorities while influencing cross-functional outcomes
  • Willingness to travel

Additional Skills We Value

  • Operational comfort in hybrid customer models (e.g., self-serve, mid-market, enterprise)
  • Experience in startup-to-growth SaaS stages, including operational scaling
  • Demonstrated success during high-growth scaling periods ($20M–$100M ARR)
  • Experience navigating evolving product offerings and pricing models

We Offer US-based Employees:

  • Competitive salary + Equity
  • Outstanding Medical and Dental benefits, including 100% employer-paid options
  • Company-paid Life and Disability insurance
  • Optional vision and supplemental insurance options, and various Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • Open Paid Time Off policy + 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents
  • Matching 401(k) plan (5% up to $5,000 yearly)
  • $1,000 annual professional development stipend
  • Monthly home working/digital lifestyle stipend, new MacBook, and one-time accessory reimbursement
  • Access to company-paid professional coaching service
  • Visits to HQ in Durham, North Carolina for remote employees

Compensation

Additional Information

Spreedly Product Offering:

Spreedly provides an open payments platform. The platform’s connectivity provides payments performance. Key products and services include:

Connect — A unified API that integrates with hundreds of payment gateways, processors, and alternative payment methods worldwide, including digital wallets. Merchants access the global payments ecosystem through one connection.
Vault — A PCI-compliant secure repository for payment methods. Merchants store card data once and reuse it across any payment service, reducing PCI scope and protecting cardholder data at scale.
Optimize — Workflow-driven routing and retry logic that directs each transaction to the best-performing gateway in real time. On average, 7.9% of failed transactions succeed immediately when retried on a secondary gateway. This is where merchants recover lost revenue and increase authorization success rates.
Protect — A flexible fraud and authentication layer, incorporating advanced fraud tools and 3DS. Following Spreedly's acquisition of Dodgeball in September 2025, fraud orchestration and payment optimization now operate within the same platform.
Resolve — Centralized management and reporting that reduces operational silos, strengthens security, and improves billing control across a merchant's entire payment operation.
More Coming Soon! - Keep your eyes peeled for a new product launch by EOY '26

--

What It's Like to Work Here:

We describe our team as "Spreedlings": diverse, forward-thinking, and driven by a shared belief that a more open payments ecosystem benefits everyone. The company operates with a culture built on transparency, courageous collaboration, and self-driven leadership. The team values simplicity in both product and process, and approaches problem-solving with genuine curiosity.

--

We champion the ethical, creative use of AI—if you’re someone who pairs human judgment with modern AI tools to work smarter and drive bigger impact, you’ll thrive here.

--

Spreedly is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We actively work to drive out even unintentional discrimination in our hiring processes via practices like blindly graded work samples, structured interviews, and diversity awareness training.

Due to the sensitive nature of what Spreedly does - handling payment data - finalist candidates must complete a successful background and reference check.

At this time Spreedly is unable to provide sponsorship for employment, and we are not set up to support remote employees who reside in New York. In order to be considered for employment, applicants must be currently legally authorized to work in the job location country and not require future sponsorship in order to continue working in that country.

We appreciate your interest in our company. Because of the high volume of resume flow, we may only respond to those candidates that we think will be a potential fit.

Fraud Risk Manager

About Aspora

People on the move deserve a bank that moves with them. Since 2022, Aspora has been building a borderless financial operating system that makes money as mobile and transparent as its users.

Backed by influential venture capitalists like Sequoia Capital, Greylock Partners, Hummingbird Ventures, Y Combinator & Global Founders Capital. We're a team of 150+ across India, the UK, the UAE, EU and the US, working with extreme ownership, radical candour, and an obsession with customer impact.

We celebrate builders who question assumptions, ship fast, and turn regulatory complexity into elegant solutions. If you’re driven to redefine what global banking can be, we’d love to build the future with you.

About the Role

People build lives across borders, and their money should move with them. Every product, corridor and payment rail we add opens a new door for fraudsters. We want to be the least attractive target on our corridors, without adding friction for good customers. This role exists to own how we detect and deter fraud across every rail and geo.

You’ll lead fraud detection and deterrence end to end, from exposure mapping to rules, limits and customer protection. You report to our Head of Financial Crime and work alongside the fraud recovery and chargebacks lead. You partner with Product, Payments, Engineering, Customer Support and Compliance on every launch. You decide what ships on day one, and you own the trade-off between fraud caught and friction added.

Who You Are

You don’t see fraud as a dashboard to watch. You see it as a live contest, won or lost in seconds, and you’ve been in it.

  • You’ve done multiple rodeos. You’ve worked fraud at more than one fintech or high-velocity regulated platform across the UK, EU or US. That could be a neobank, payments company, gambling operator, gaming platform or crypto exchange. You know how attacks, rails and rules differ in each.

  • You’ve built controls from scratch. At a B2C fintech, you built fraud controls that didn’t exist before, while protecting consumer money at scale.

  • You’ve worked the floor. You started as an investigator and worked alerts and cases by hand. You spot a pattern before it shows on a dashboard.

  • You’ve been baptised by fire. You’ve handled a real fraud attack or loss spike and made fast calls under pressure. You stayed on it until the fix held, and learned from every case.

  • You own the approach. You decide how to tackle a problem and see it through end to end, without waiting to be told.

  • You see every launch as a new door. You map where fraud can get in before go-live, not after the first losses land.

  • You protect good customers too. You stop fraud without adding friction for the people we serve, and you can show the numbers behind it.

Most importantly, you’d rather build the right controls once, on our own decisioning platform, than tune vendor defaults forever.

What You’ll Own

This is a role with a mandate across every rail, product and geo we operate in.

  • See the exposure, everywhere. Map where fraud can hit us on every rail, product and geo, and own the observability layer that lets us watch it live.

  • Build rules that hold. Stand up rule building and governance on our decisioning platform, with every change back-tested before it ships.

  • Tier exposure by risk. Design progressive access to payment rails by risk tier, so trusted customers move freely and limits grow with trust.

  • Measure every trade-off. Track each control change in fraud caught against friction added, and retire the rules that no longer earn their place.

  • Protect customers in the moment. Put vulnerable-customer education and in-the-moment verification on every rail, without slowing good customers down.

Strategic Partnerships Lead

About DataSnipper

Audit is the bedrock of the global economy. DataSnipper builds the AI that auditors and finance teams rely on to do that work with confidence: agents designed around how audits are actually performed, a platform firms trust with their most sensitive client evidence, and a team built around former auditors who know the work firsthand. We want to define how the profession works in the age of AI.

More than 600,000 professionals across 175 countries use DataSnipper, including all Big Four firms, Fortune 500 companies, and government agencies. In 2025 alone, we delivered over $1.4 billion in productivity savings for our customers. Backed by Index Ventures and Insight Partners, we are one of the fastest-growing companies in AI for audit, and the fastest-growing tech company in the Netherlands two years running.

Everything we build starts from one principle: AI in audit has to be something professionals can trust, verify, and defend. Joining now means helping lead the profession's shift from manual testing to agentic execution.


The Role


Partnerships are one of DataSnipper's most important growth levers. Across every major market, the consulting firms, technology platforms, and professional networks that organizations rely on shape which technologies their teams and clients adopt. As AI changes how audit work gets done, those partners are deciding who to build with.

As Strategic Partnerships Lead, you will lead, build, and launch DataSnipper's partnerships across Europe and the wider EMEA region, spanning our consulting alliances, key technology partners, and strategic relationships across the audit ecosystem and beyond. Our European ecosystem already includes relationships with leading consulting firms and regional networks. Your job is to scale it, and to build what comes next: new partner programs, new markets, and new commercial models.

This is an entrepreneurial, quota-carrying role with a broad remit and room to build. You will report to the Global Partnerships Leader and work closely with our EMEA Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Marketing teams.


What You Will Work On

  • Own and grow a portfolio of strategic partners across Europe, including consulting firms, technology platforms, and regional networks, and act as their senior counterpart at DataSnipper.

  • Scale existing partnerships into multi-country programs, and launch new ones market by market, adapting to local regulatory, commercial, and cultural nuances.

  • Source, assess, and close new partnerships, from referral and co-sell arrangements to resell models, prioritized against DataSnipper's growth goals.

  • Work with consulting partners to help them advise their clients on bringing AI into audit and finance, with DataSnipper at the center of that work.

  • Build joint go-to-market plans with each partner, covering account mapping, co-selling, events, and executive engagement, that turn relationships into pipeline and closed revenue.

  • Deepen key technology partnerships across the region to unlock co-sell, marketplace, and joint solution opportunities.

  • Create the enablement, playbooks, and co-marketing assets partners need to position and deliver DataSnipper with confidence.

  • Own partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue targets, and report on performance with clear, honest data.

  • Bring partner feedback from across Europe back into DataSnipper, so what you hear in the field shapes product, packaging, and pricing.

  • Be a visible face of DataSnipper across the region, at partner summits, field events, and industry forums.

  • Willingness to embrace global business and travel.

What You Bring

  • 5 to 7 years of experience in partnerships, business development, or a senior commercial role, ideally in B2B SaaS, AI, or financial technology.

  • A proven track record of independently managing and growing complex, multi-stakeholder partnerships from identification through to revenue impact.

  • Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to negotiate partnership structures, co-sell agreements, and commercial terms with senior counterparts.

  • Experience building joint go-to-market programs and driving pipeline through partner channels across more than one European market.

  • Excellent relationship-building and influencing skills, with the credibility to work as a peer with firm leadership, from alliance leads to managing directors and partners.

  • Existing relationships with consulting firm leadership in Europe are a strong advantage.

How You Work

  • Entrepreneurial. When you spot a gap, you build what fills it, playbook or not.

  • High standards. You hold yourself, and the partners you work with, to a high bar.

  • Close to the work. You dig into how audit gets done, how firms make decisions, and where AI changes the economics.

  • Accountable. You measure yourself by results, and you own them when they fall short.

  • Fast and rigorous. You move quickly without cutting corners, because in audit the details matter.

  • Generous with your team. You share what you learn, give credit freely, and make the people and partners around you better.

Why This Role, Why Now

  • Momentum: Used across the world's leading audit institutions, including all Big Four firms. A $100M Series B led by Index Ventures at a $1B valuation, building on earlier investment from Insight Partners. Ranked #1 on the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 in 2023 and 2024, named to the Forbes Fintech 50 for 2026, and one of the fastest-growing companies in AI for audit.

  • Extraordinary team: Former Big Four auditors and audit leaders, AI engineers and researchers, and operators who have scaled category-defining software companies. Headquartered in Amsterdam, with teams across New York, Asia Pacific, and Latin America. You will be surrounded by people who are exceptional at what they do and generous with what they know.

  • Scope: You will shape how one of DataSnipper's most important growth channels scales, with direct visibility to leadership.

  • Impact: The partnerships you build will influence how the world's leading firms adopt AI across audit and assurance.

What we offer

  • Make an impact by disrupting the audit industry with us

Our answer is a machine-agnostic intelligence platform that lets any machine, on any site, perceive, decide, and act autonomously. One platform. Any machine. No fleet replacement.

Already live across multiple sites and customers in Europe - spanning logistics and warehousing, industrial manufacturing, and large-scale chemical production - with a US expansion underway.

The vision: one operator managing hundreds of machines simultaneously. Productive machine-hour cost dropping by 80x, and unlocks the next productivity revolution in physical work.

The mission is to make productivity limitless. Come and help us build it.

 

The Role

As Operations Manager you will build and run the operational organization behind Hive's live customer operations in the UK.

Following deployment handover, you will own day-to-day operational performance, including operators, shift coverage, training, quality, customer service and continuous improvement.

Initially, the role is broader. As one of Hive's first UK operational hires, you will also help establish our local setup, support early deployments and solve the practical challenges that come with building a new operation from the ground up.

Create a Strong Field Feedback Loop

  • Translate field experience into actionable improvements for Product, Engineering and Delivery.

  • Help prioritize improvements that increase safety, reliability, uptime and operational quality.

 

What We're Looking For

 

Essential

  • Experience managing industrial, field, logistics or service operations.

Product Manager, Agents

Product Manager, Agents

Vega is looking for A-players who will define and build the next generation of Agentic products that will shape the next era of private markets.

About Vega

Vega is transforming the way private markets operate. Alternative asset management is one of the most influential forces in the global economy, with over $20TN in assets today. Over the next five years, the industry is set to grow 3x, but GPs are facing challenges around their ability to handle the investment flows that are coming in. GPs have been completely underserved by innovation, particularly on the investor relations side.

Vega built the industry’s first AI-native operating system, where all client work gets done - from the start of an investor’s journey to its end. We are rethinking how work gets done in private markets from first principles: the opportunity is big, but it’s also niche, high-stakes, and difficult to get right.

Who we are

We are still at the beginning of our journey. Vega was founded by former investors at Elliott and KKR, and built by talent from the world’s leading technology and financial services firms - including Trade Republic, Revolut, Goldman Sachs, BCG, and more. We have raised $30M so far, with the backing of Apollo, Motive Partners, and 60+ senior executives from the industry. Today, we have over $300B AUM and 30,000 users on the platform, and we have much more left to do.

How we do it

Vega is a fast-growing startup. We want to make this a career-accelerating place for people with the ambition to build something big. If the below sounds appealing, it could be for you:

  1. We do not seek consensus. You will be expected to voice opinions and take initiative. Vega's best people do not wait to be told what to do before finding solutions to problems they have spotted.

  2. We believe bureaucracy is the killer of progress. We are focused on creating the minimum viable process to operate with quality at speed.

  3. We prioritise talent over tenure. There is no promise of progression without performance – we assess and reward people on impact above all else.

  4. We iterate fast. We make decisions amid ambiguity and with imperfect information, and we strive to balance committing to a hypothesis with iterating at low ego.

  5. We play to win. Expectations, intensity and ambition are very high, with every single colleague contributing to Vega's success. This often will not be a 9-5.

We know that this culture won’t be for everyone, and we endeavour to make this clear from the beginning of the recruiting process out of respect for your time. Ask yourself whether the above sounds exciting to you in practice every day, and if it does, we would love to hear from you.

Who succeeds in this role

We look for people who match our ambition levels, and then raise it further.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead and partner with engineering teams on technical concepts to deliver exceptional AI-first solutions. Prototype instead of writing specs.

  • Own an agentic surface end-to-end and decide what runs unattended and what needs a human.

  • Keep every autonomous action explainable and reversible. Own the tradeoffs on reliability, latency and cost.

  • Sit with GP and LP ops teams, find the manual work, remove it without breaking their controls.

  • Operate and deliver with a sense of urgency under ambiguous situations in a fast-paced environment where multi-tasking, strong communication and problem-solving skills are a must.

What we look for:

  • 2+ years in product, ideally somewhere where being wrong is expensive.

  • Hands-on with prompting, context engineering and evals. You've done it yourself, not managed someone who did.

  • You've shipped LLM or agent features to real users, and can say what broke.

  • Enough technical fluency to argue with engineers about retrieval and tool design. Good judgement to know when AI is the wrong answer.

  • Working with GPs/LPs and/or knowledge of Fund administration, KYC/AML or LP portals is an advantage.

Why join us?

  • You will help define the transformation of one of the most influential industries of our time with AI, working alongside an ambitious and dedicated team

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Benefits including medical insurance, gym membership, learning budget, and more

jobs.title: Network Customer Support Engineer
jobs.description:
Network Customer Support Engineer

Location: Zurich, Paris or Munich

Language: Fluency in a two European languages in addition to English.

About Us

Point One Navigation is building the future of precise location. Our mission is to deliver a unified location platform that enables autonomy, safety, and efficiency across industries from robotics to transportation. We are a high-performance, high-collaboration team that thrives on solving complex problems, moving fast, and delivering impact.

Role Outcome

The Network Customer Support Engineer owns the customer support experience tied to the reliability, visibility, and operational health of Point One’s correction network.

This is a player-coach role. You will personally handle complex technical support cases while also leading the operational systems, monitoring, and processes that ensure the network performs reliably at scale.

Success in this role means:

  • Potential customer facing issues are identified and addressed before they impact customers.

  • When incidents do occur, they are resolved quickly with clear communication and strong root-cause analysis.

  • The organization has clear visibility into network health, operational trends, and customer friction.

  • A scalable network operations and support function is built as the company and network footprint grow.

Immediate Areas of Focus

Own the customer experience of our Network

  • Work with our Network Operations team to understand incidents that affect the customer experience

  • Identify emerging issues and collaborate with engineering and manufacturing teams to understand and support the resolution of those issues.

  • Understand available metrics and dashboards and contribute to the development of these tools to allow for the targeted resolution of customer questions.

Deliver High-Quality Technical Support

  • Liaison between Engineering, Network Operations and FAE and FDE team to support the customer.

  • Personally manage high-impact or technically complex support cases.

  • Partner closely with FAEs, Product, and Engineering to diagnose issues and close the loop with customers.

  • Ensure customers receive clear, confident communication during investigations and incidents.

  • Model best-in-class technical troubleshooting and customer engagement practices for the team.

Build the Foundation for a Scalable Operations & Support Function

  • Design and implement systems that enable both network operations and customer support to scale.

  • Define a support ticket taxonomy that reflects customer use cases, technical complexity, and operational impact.

  • Support Network Ops team on operational metrics such as:

    • Network uptime and availability

    • Incident response and resolution times

    • Support response and resolution times

    • Alert quality and monitoring coverage

    • Document operational procedures, escalation paths, and ownership models.

  • Develop automation and tooling to reduce manual work and improve operational efficiency.

Surface Operational and Customer Insights

  • Identify patterns across support tickets, network events, and operational data.

  • Translate operational signals into actionable insights for Product and Engineering.

  • Ensure recurring issues and infrastructure gaps are clearly surfaced and prioritized.

  • Create lightweight reporting that gives leadership visibility into network reliability, operational trends, and customer friction.

Establish Visibility Into Customer Experience

  • Define and implement the right metrics for understanding customer experience and operational impact.

  • Establish mechanisms to collect structured customer feedback without creating noise.

  • Use both operational data and customer feedback to drive continuous improvement.

Coach and Develop the Operations & Support Function

  • Act as a player-coach, leading through hands-on operational work while building the foundations of the team.

  • Train and mentor support engineers on troubleshooting methodology, operational awareness, and customer communication.

  • Establish clear expectations for technical depth, ownership, and responsiveness.

  • Continuously raise the operational and support bar as the team grows.

Qualifications

  • Fluency in a two European languages in addition to English.

  • Experience in a player-coach technical operations or support role where you owned both hands-on troubleshooting and operational systems.

  • Strong technical background in GPS/GNSS, precise localization, geospatial infrastructure, or closely related domains (robotics, autonomy, embedded systems, positioning technologies).

  • Experience operating or supporting distributed infrastructure or network-based systems.

  • Demonstrated ability to build or significantly improve monitoring, alerting, and operational processes.

  • Proven experience troubleshooting complex technical systems and working directly with customers.

  • Experience conducting incident response and root cause analysis.

  • Ability to define metrics, processes, and documentation without over-engineering.

  • Comfort working cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, and Go-To-Market teams in a fast-moving environment.

  • Bias toward ownership, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

Our Cultural Foundation

At Point One, our cultural and operating design is built around one guiding principle: we must move with extreme speed and efficiency of effort to stay in a leadership position.

This environment gives people a high level of autonomy and the ability to make a real impact. It also challenges every team member to grow — both professionally and personally. Because we focus on promoting from within rather than relying on external hiring, the opportunities for advancement are tremendous for those who seek them.

That said, growth only comes from delivering in the present. What matters most is the job to be done today, not the job you want tomorrow. When we all focus on today’s outcomes with excellence, the path to greater responsibility and growth naturally follows.

We think about our culture in two dimensions:

How We Show Up Every Day

These are the behaviors we expect every team member to bring to work — the foundation of being a consummate, high-output teammate:

  • Trust / Assume Best Intent — Trust allows us to move fast. When we start from trust, we spend no time second-guessing or looking for ulterior motives and thus focus all our energy on acting.

  • High Output, Action Oriented — Our default posture is “yes.” We bias toward action and deliver results quickly, knowing that speed and efficiency compound into impact as we unblock others around us.

  • Divine Discontent — We’re never satisfied with the status quo and are self-motivated to improve ourselves, our work, and our company. We actively seek feedback in real-time to shorten improvement cycles.

  • No Ego, One Team — Collaboration without ego creates leverage. When we win as one team, we eliminate friction and move faster together.

  • Self Accountability — Taking ownership is the straightest line to learning, self-improvement, and correcting our course of action. And blaming others around us is a fast path to destroying trust.

Operating Principles

These are the systems and norms that amplify speed and efficiency at the company level:

  • Edge Innovation — We bias toward action over approval. Experiment, decide, and move — failure is just a step toward faster learning.

  • No Hierarchies — We practice self-prioritization and go direct to the source. Flattening layers reduces drag and maximizes autonomy.

  • Customer Experience First — We optimize for the end-to-end customer outcome, not functional or departmental efficiency. This focus cuts waste, aligns priorities, and ensures we spend effort where it matters most.

If this role sounds like a fit, we’d love to hear from you. Apply below and join us in shaping the future of precise location.

About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

About The Role

Commissioning is where an AI factory becomes real. As Senior Director, Global Commissioning & Handover, you will lead commissioning of DSX facilities and network across all of Volta's sites, taking each one to ready for service and handing it over to our operations teams.

You will build and lead a global team that owns Volta's commissioning standards for electrical, mechanical and CDU scopes, systems security, commissioning planning, facilities readiness and operational readiness. Your team sets how commissioning is done on every site, from tagging through to the turn-up sequence, and holds the schedule that takes each facility live.

Time to market matters here. You will align commissioning to the turn-up sequence so that commissioning accelerates service rather than delays it, and you will make sure that when a building is handed over, the operations team, the procedures and the systems are ready to run it.

  • Lead commissioning of DSX facilities and network infrastructure across Volta's AI factories, taking each site to ready for service.

  • Own Volta's commissioning standards for each discipline, from tagging and method statements through each commissioning level to the turn-up sequence.

  • Own CDU installation and commissioning standards, including handover to operations.

  • Own the commissioning schedule for every site and its alignment to turn-up, so that commissioning is never the critical path to service.

  • Deliver the physical and systems security requirements for each site from construction through tohandover.

  • Lead handover into service, working with DC Operations on acceptance, documentation and training.

  • Work with Design and Engineering, the regional delivery teams and the DSX execution and network teams so commissioning is integrated into the master schedule on every site.

jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Security Engineer

WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN US

  • Work on a civilisation-scale problem - Clean, baseload fusion energy is one of the few genuinely world-changing challenges, and every hire directly accelerates the path to a working stellarator.

  • Grow as fast as the company does - With headcount set to roughly 5x in a few years and major technical milestones ahead on the path to our demo machine and first power plant, your role grows under you; today's hire is tomorrow's function lead.

  • Tackle problems that don't exist elsewhere - Fusion sits at a rare intersection of deep-tech R&D, industrial procurement, government relations, and venture financing, so non-tech functions face challenges no other workplace can offer.

YOUR IMPACT

As our Senior Security Engineer in Munich, you will own security implementation and security monitoring, digital and physical, for a company building one of the most valuable bodies of fusion IP in Europe. Protecting it is its own challenge, and you are the person who will own it.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Build out our security monitoring capability: select and run the SIEM, decide what's worth alerting on, and tune out the noise.

• Own incident response end-to-end, from investigation through to a post-mortem and a fix that holds.

• Harden the environment hands-on across endpoint and EDR, identity and access, network, and infrastructure.

• Finish maturing Zero Trust: identity and device posture as joint conditions for access, and MFA everywhere.

• Handle the long tail of edge cases that comes with a fast-growing team and a lot of contractors.

• Secure our Google-centric workplace, where most of our IP moves — DLP, data classification and labeling, retention, and context-aware access.

• Secure the software supply chain in collaboration with our platform team: source control, access boundaries, secrets, and CI/CD.

• Run vulnerability and attack surface management, and drive remediation to be done with the teams that own the systems.

• Set and monitor our physical security standard with Business Operations, who implement it on site: access zones, CCTV and alerting, visitor and contractor access, and site access as one joiner-mover-leaver process with digital access, across multiple locations.

• Give our compliance work the technical substance it needs: evidence, remediation, and support through audits and pen tests.

WHO YOU ARE

Must have

• You have 5+ years hands-on in security engineering, with real depth in identity, endpoint, and infrastructure.

• You have built or substantially operated a SIEM, and run real incidents end-to-end.

• You have implemented Zero Trust in production - unified IdP and MDM, conditional access, device posture.

• You know Google Workspace Enterprise security well, or can get there fast from an equivalent platform.

• You are automation-first: Terraform, and scripting in Python, Bash, or PowerShell are no strangers to you.

• You are fluent in CIS Benchmarks, NIST, ISO 27001, and NIS2 without being ruled by them.

• You can turn a technical finding into a business impact and actionable solutions

Nice to have

• Interest or a track record in AI security.

• Hands-on cloud and container security: GCP, containers, Kubernetes.

• Certifications such as CISSP, GCIA, GCIH, CCSP, or Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer.

• Experience in a regulated, export-controlled, or high-security environment, where physical and digital security meet.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

  • CEO call (30 min)

Customer Service Advisor

About BSI

BSI Merch & Artist Services runs design, supply, fulfilment and e-commerce for artists and their labels and management. We build and run official artist web stores on Shopify for the UK and EU, ship from our warehouses in Leamington Spa and Berlin, and support album campaigns from pre-order through to release week, for artists including Franz Ferdinand, Kneecap, Frank Turner and We Are Palace.

Every order through those stores is a fan buying something from an artist they care about. Customer Services is where that relationship is won or lost.

The Role

You'll answer customers across our artist stores, resolve order, delivery and returns issues end to end, and feed what you learn back to the wider e-commerce team so problems get fixed at the source.

What we are looking for

You bring professional experience in customer service, clear communication skills, and a practical approach to resolving support requests in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Customer support

  • Respond to customer tickets by email and chat through Gorgias, across multiple artist stores and in each store's tone.

  • Handle order queries end to end: tracking, delivery delays, address changes, missing items, pre-order dates and cancellations.

  • Manage returns, exchanges, refunds and reships, including damaged and faulty items, collecting photo evidence and processing returns through Loop Returns.

  • Resolve complaints fairly and within our service standards (acknowledgement within 2 working days, resolution within 14 calendar days), escalating to the CS Lead where needed.

  • Apply UK and EU consumer rights correctly, including the 14-day cancellation period and its exceptions.

Working with the wider team

  • Chase stock and fulfilment issues with the warehouse and Product team, and flag anything that needs a reship or a hold on stock.

  • Raise patterns early to the Head of Customer Service and/or relevant department

Housekeeping and reporting

  • Keep the queue clean: tag tickets accurately, close spam and auto-replies, and keep macros and Help Centre articles up to date where required.

  • Log refunds, reships, common issues and recurring problems so they feed into the monthly CS report for each client.

  • Help maintain and improve the AI Agent's guidance and the CS Help Centre for new stores.

Launches and release weeks

Our workload follows the music. A store launch, a pre-sale or an album release can bring hundreds of tickets in a few days, and the questions shift with each stage of the campaign.

  • Pre-order and pre-access: questions about access codes, dispatch dates and what's included in bundles.

  • Release week: high volume around delivery timing, signed items and chart-eligible bundles, where getting media to customers on time matters.

  • After release: returns, damaged items, missing parcels and reship requests.

You'll need to stay calm and accurate under pressure, prioritise the tickets that matter most, and occasionally flex your hours around a launch.

Skills and experience

Essential

  • At least 1 year in customer service, ideally for an e-commerce or retail brand.

  • Clear, warm written English and German, with the judgement to adjust tone for different artists and fanbases.

  • Comfortable working a busy ticket queue and hitting response times.

  • Organised and detail-focused: order numbers, SKUs, addresses and refunds need to be right first time.

  • Confident using helpdesk software and picking up new systems quickly.

  • Knows when to resolve and when to escalate.

Desirable

  • Experience with Gorgias, Shopify or Loop Returns.

  • Knowledge of UK and EU consumer rights for online purchases.

  • Experience in music, merchandise or entertainment retail.

  • An interest in music and the artists we work with.

What we offer

  • Work with a wide range of artists, from emerging acts to established names

  • A great, fast-growing team

  • A modern office in Kreuzberg

  • Discounts on a monthly BVG ticket and Urban Sports Club membership
