jobs.title: GTM Operations Manager
jobs.description:
GTM Operations Manager

RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile.

We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance.

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.

The role

We’re looking for a GTM Operations Manager to build and improve the workflows that connect our go-to-market teams.

A promising account signs up. Does the right person find out, with enough context to act? A customer becomes eligible for a new product. Do they receive useful guidance? A data sync fails overnight. Do we catch it before it affects a campaign, account handoff, or business decision?

You’ll help make those things work reliably.

You’ll join an existing GTM Operations team, working closely with @Nathan Bellehsen on Salesforce and Sales systems and @Masha Tsaryk on Marketing and customer-lifecycle systems. Your initial focus will be lead handoffs and lifecycle execution: the data, automation, quality checks, and reporting that turn customer signals into useful action.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role. You’ll own agreed projects from understanding the problem through building, testing, rollout, and ongoing improvement. Experienced teammates will provide context, help set priorities, and partner with you on architectural decisions. Within that direction, we expect you to make progress independently and flag problems early.

Our stack includes Salesforce, Customer.io, Clay, Looker, automation tools, and a growing set of AI workflows. You don’t need to know every tool. You do need to understand how systems connect and enjoy figuring out why something isn’t working.

Why we’re hiring for this role now

RevenueCat’s GTM organization is growing across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Growth. We’re developing more deliberate ways to identify promising accounts, help customers adopt our products, and turn successful one-to-one work into programs that reach many more people.

Our operations team already supports the systems behind that work. We need more capacity to take important workflows from “this could work” to something dependable that people use every day.

You’ll help us ship those improvements while making the existing operation easier to run: fewer manual handoffs, clearer ownership, more trustworthy data, and less time spent solving the same problem twice.

What you’ll be responsible for

  • Own selected GTM workflows end-to-end. Translate a business problem into a practical solution, agree how success will be measured, build and test it, and stay responsible after launch.

  • Make lead and account handoffs dependable. Build and improve enrichment, qualification, routing, alerts, and follow-up visibility. Help ensure important signals reach a named owner, and make missed or failed handoffs visible.

  • Put lifecycle programs into production. Partner with Marketing and Customer Growth on audience definitions, triggers, exclusions, data syncs, campaign QA, and measurement. Turn repeatable requests into workflows and templates teammates can use.

  • Keep data connected and usable. Trace how account, contact, and product-usage data moves between systems. Investigate stale records, duplicates, mismatched relationships, and failed syncs; fix what you can and work with the relevant system or Data owner on deeper issues.

  • Build automation that holds up in everyday use. Test realistic scenarios and edge cases, monitor failures, and make it clear how to recover when something breaks. Bring consequential changes to the relevant system owner before rollout.

  • Use AI where it improves the work. Build or improve workflows for tasks such as enrichment, research, qualification, and quality checks. Evaluate the output, understand the failure modes, and measure whether the result saves time or improves quality.

  • Make what you build understandable and useful. Document your workflows, enable the people using them, gather feedback, and improve adoption. Share knowledge so another teammate can operate and troubleshoot your work. Keep documentation current as workflows change, and fill gaps in the existing processes you take on.

  • Make operational performance visible. Build and maintain reports that help teams understand workflow health, handoff gaps, campaign execution, and adoption. Work with senior Ops teammates and Data on consistent definitions.

What you’ll need to be successful

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in GTM, revenue, marketing, sales, or customer operations.

  • Practical Salesforce experience. You understand objects, relationships, fields, flows, and how data moves through the system. You have built or changed things yourself.

  • Experience building in a marketing automation platform such as Customer.io, HubSpot, Marketo, Braze, or Iterable, including segmentation, triggers, and integrations.

  • Experience building something useful with AI. You can explain the problem, your contribution, how you checked the result, what failed, and what you changed. A sanitized walkthrough is welcome; we don’t expect confidential work from a previous employer.

  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical judgment. You can trace a problem across systems, check your assumptions against data, and distinguish a symptom from its cause.

  • Ownership and follow-through. You can take an agreed problem, work through ambiguity, communicate tradeoffs, and deliver without needing every step assigned.

  • Clear written communication. You keep stakeholders informed, document decisions, and explain technical problems in language others can act on.

  • Care for the details. You think about the wrong audience, missing record, duplicate trigger, or failed handoff before it becomes someone else’s problem.

  • Learning agility and adaptability. You can transfer what you know to unfamiliar tools and adjust your plan when priorities change, while keeping commitments and stakeholders informed.

Ideally, you

  • Have worked in a product-led or usage-based business with both self-service and Sales-assisted customers.

  • Have connected CRM, marketing automation, customer-success, or product-usage systems.

  • Can use SQL, APIs, webhooks, or lightweight scripts to investigate data and connect tools.

  • Have improved adoption of an internal tool or replaced repeated manual work with a maintained workflow.

  • Have supported customer onboarding, product adoption, lifecycle education, or account-coverage programs.

What success looks like

Within the first month, you’ll:

  • Learn how customers move through RevenueCat and how our GTM teams support them.

  • Map an initial workflow with @Nathan Bellehsen and @Masha Tsaryk, including its data sources, owners, dependencies, and common failure points.

  • Ship your first useful improvement as part of RevenueCat’s “first ship” tradition.

  • Agree your initial ownership area and a prioritized set of problems to solve.

Within the first three months, you’ll:

  • Own the day-to-day operation of an agreed set of lead and/or lifecycle workflows.

  • Deliver an improvement from scoping through rollout, with clear documentation and stakeholder feedback.

  • Establish baseline measures and monitoring for the workflows you own.

  • Give another teammate enough context to support your work when you’re away.

Within the first six months, you’ll:

  • Demonstrate measurable improvement in a core workflow, such as fewer missed handoffs, faster campaign delivery, fresher data, or less manual effort.

  • Turn recurring operational requests into reusable processes.

  • Show that the people your workflows serve are using them successfully, and improve what isn’t working.

Within the first twelve months, you’ll:

  • Independently deliver projects across systems within your areas of ownership.

  • Have a track record of reliable workflows, useful automation, and improvements that make GTM teams more effective.

  • Help shape the next priorities using evidence from users, operational performance, and customer needs.

  • Be developing deeper expertise and taking on progressively more complex work.

What we offer:

  • Competitive equity in a fast-growing, Series C startup backed by top-tier investors, including Y Combinator

  • 10-year window to exercise vested equity options

  • A fully remote environment designed around autonomy and flexibility

  • 4-5 weeks of flexible time off annually

  • Paid desk at a co-working space

  • Workspace budget and continuous learning stipend

Interviewing at RevenueCat

Our interview process is rigorous on purpose. We want to be sure that everyone we bring on is genuinely excited about this work, aligned with how we operate, and ready to meet our high bar for performance. Curious what that actually looks like? Read more in our blog post on how we hire at RevenueCat, including tips to help you succeed.

More on how we work:

  • How we think about hiring and team design: Building a Winning Team

  • The values that guide how we work: Our Values

  • How we work as a remote team: How We Work Remotely at RevenueCat

  • What to expect from our interview process: Interview Expectations

  • What to expect from comp and employment: Employment FAQ

Meet us there and tell us what excites you.

Life at Nabla

When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe clinicians should be able to focus on what they were trained to do, caring for their patients, and that no patient should feel their visit was rushed.

We work hard and make time to have fun, too. Our #nablabla channel is just as active as #feature-show-off. We support well-being with workday activities at least three times a week; choose from yoga, running, Pilates, or HIIT. We also host regular off-sites, meet up across New York, Paris, San Francisco, and other cities, and keep the chocolate and nuts well stocked.

If this sounds like an environment where you’ll thrive, we look forward to reading your application.

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift

Committed to diversity

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed

There is an active employment and financial scam which uses Nabla to collect personal information. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure they are utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity. You can find more information following this link.


Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla.

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth.

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation. This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies.

You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO).

Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy & Optimization

  • Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic.
  • Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis.
  • Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance.
  • Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data.
  • Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates.
  • Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO).

Paid Advertising & Lead Generation

  • Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
  • Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).

Content Marketing & Website Management

  • Collaborate with designers, developers, and content creators to improve website performance and user experience.

Analytics, Reporting & Optimization

  • Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager.
  • Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports.
  • Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns.
  • Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.

Marketing Automation & CRM

  • Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows.
  • Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign.
  • Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs.
  • Maintain accurate campaign data and performance reporting.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools.
  • Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns.
  • Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms.
  • Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels.
  • Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines.
  • Availability during U.S. Business Hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

  • Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses.
  • Experience with Looker Studio and advanced marketing reporting.
  • Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results.
  • You understand how SEO, paid advertising, content, and conversion optimization work together.
  • You can independently develop strategies, execute campaigns, and analyze performance.
  • You’re proactive about identifying growth opportunities and testing improvements.
  • You stay informed about search engine updates and emerging AI-powered marketing trends.
  • You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with remote teams.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions.

You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements.

In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Organic Traffic Growth: Increase qualified organic website traffic.
  • Keyword Rankings: Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords.
  • Lead Generation: Increase marketing-qualified leads from organic and paid channels.
  • Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Controller
jobs.description:
Senior Financial Controller

MVRDV zoekt een Senior Financial Controller om ons Finance & Operations team in Rotterdam te versterken.

Je bent de financiële rechterhand van onze Head of Finance en de dagelijkse sparringpartner voor Project Managers, Directors en collega's binnen Finance. Je speelt een belangrijke rol in zowel project control als financial control en zorgt ervoor dat financiële informatie betrouwbaar, tijdig en bruikbaar is voor de organisatie.

Je ondersteunt Project Managers bij het monitoren en verbeteren van projectresultaten, terwijl je tegelijkertijd bijdraagt aan een hoogwaardige financiële verslaggeving, een betrouwbare jaarafsluiting en een succesvolle accountantscontrole. Met jouw analytische blik, financiële expertise en hands-on mentaliteit lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan de verdere professionalisering van onze financiële organisatie.

MVRDV is een wereldwijd erkend bureau voor architectuur en stedenbouw, met hoofdkantoor in Rotterdam en vestigingen in Shanghai, Parijs, Berlijn en New York. Opgericht in 1993 door Winy Maas, Jacob van Rijs en Nathalie de Vries, ontwerpt MVRDV innovatieve, sociaal verantwoorde en duurzame architectuur die de toekomst vormgeeft. Als collega bij MVRDV maak je deel uit van een energiek, internationaal team van meer dan 250 professionals uit meer dan 40 nationaliteiten.

Verantwoordelijkheden

Project Control

  • Samenwerken met Project Managers bij het opstellen en beoordelen van projectbudgetten, fee-calculaties en forecasts.

  • Financiële projectprestaties monitoren, waaronder omzet, kosten, marge, WIP en cashflow, en risico's en kansen tijdig signaleren.

  • Variantie- en scenarioanalyses uitvoeren en de resultaten vertalen naar praktisch advies over winstgevendheid, facturatie en cashflow.

  • Project Managers ondersteunen bij projectopstart, maandelijkse reviews en projectafsluiting.

  • Zorgen voor een correcte projectopzet, coderingsstructuren en kostentoewijzingen.

  • Urenregistraties en projecttoewijzingen controleren op juistheid en consistentie.

  • Inefficiënties in projectuitvoering signaleren en bijdragen aan margeverbetering.

Financial Control

  • Verantwoordelijk voor de coördinatie en kwaliteitsbewaking van de financiële verslaggeving en de jaarrekening, inclusief relevante specificaties, balansdossiers en aansluitingen.

  • Verantwoordelijk voor de regie op de jaarlijkse accountantscontrole en de samenwerking met externe accountants, waarbij wordt gezorgd voor een efficiënte en succesvolle afronding van het controleproces.

  • Bewaken van de volledigheid en juistheid van financiële processen, interne beheersingsmaatregelen en financiële gegevens ter ondersteuning van een betrouwbare jaarafsluiting.

  • Signaleren van verbetermogelijkheden binnen financiële processen en bijdragen aan verdere professionalisering van de financiële organisatie.

  • Ondersteunen bij maand-, kwartaal- en jaarafsluitingen en zorgen voor betrouwbare financiële rapportages.

Business Control & Business Partnering

  • Bijdragen aan bedrijfsbrede budgettering, forecasting en lange termijn planning.

  • Helpen bij het opstellen van managementrapportages, KPI-dashboards en financiële analyses.

  • Projectresultaten verbinden aan de totale financiële prestaties van de organisatie.

  • Projectbudgetten afstemmen op bezetting en capaciteitsplanning.

  • Financiële data vertalen naar heldere, bruikbare adviezen voor niet-financiële collega's.

  • Management ondersteunen bij business cases, scenarioanalyses en besluitvorming.


Wie zoeken wij?

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in Finance, Bedrijfseconomie, Accountancy of vergelijkbaar.

  • Minimaal 7 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen financial control, business control, accountancy of een vergelijkbare financiële functie.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met jaarafsluitingen, financiële verslaggeving en jaarrekeningen.

  • Ervaring met accountantscontroles en samenwerking met externe accountants.

  • Ervaring binnen een projectgedreven organisatie, bij voorkeur in architectuur, engineering, consultancy of een vergelijkbare omgeving.

  • Een sterk begrip van financiële rapportage, project accounting en interne beheersing.

  • Gevorderde Excel-vaardigheden en ervaring met ERP- en BI-tools.

  • Vloeiend Engels; Nederlands is een pré.

  • Analytisch, gestructureerd en kwaliteitsgericht.

  • In staat financiële vraagstukken begrijpelijk te maken voor niet-financiële stakeholders.

  • Proactief, zelfstandig en gericht op verbetering.



Wat bieden wij?

Bij MVRDV krijg je de kans om impact te maken binnen een internationaal, creatief en ondernemend bureau. Je werkt nauw samen met Project Managers, Directors en Financeteam van 5 collega’s en speelt een belangrijke rol in de verdere professionalisering van onze organisatie.

Wij bieden je:

  • Een uitdagende en afwisselende functie met veel verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte voor initiatief.

  • Een internationale werkomgeving met collega's en projecten over de hele wereld.

  • Volop mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling.

  • Onbeperkte toegang tot OpenUp, korting met Urban Sports, een gezonde lunch geserveerd, een NS Business Card en een laptop.

jobs.title: Enterprise, Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Enterprise, Customer Success Manager

About DeleteMe:

DeleteMe is the leader in proactive privacy protection. We help security teams reduce their human attack surface by continuously monitoring and removing exposed personal data (PII) from the open web — the very data threat actors use to launch social engineering, phishing, Gen-AI deepfake, doxxing campaigns, physical threats, and identity fraud.

Operating as a fast-growing, global SaaS company, DeleteMe serves both consumers and enterprises. DeleteMe has completed over 100 million opt-out removals, helping customers reduce risks associated with identity theft, spam, doxxing, and other cybersecurity threats. We deliver detailed privacy reports, continuous monitoring, and expert support to ensure ongoing protection.

DeleteMe acts as a scalable, managed defense layer for your most vulnerable attack vector: your people. That’s why 30% of the Fortune 100, top tech firms, major banks, federal agencies, and U.S. states rely on DeleteMe to protect their workforce.

DeleteMe is led by a passionate and experienced team and driven by a powerful mission to empower consumers with privacy.

Job Summary

As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you will own and shape the post-sale experience for enterprise customers who rely on DeleteMe to protect the highly sensitive personal data of their executives and employees. This role goes beyond traditional customer success: you will serve as a trusted privacy advisor to enterprise stakeholders, helping them operationalize privacy protection, drive adoption across complex organizations, and measurably reduce risk exposure for the people and organizations they serve.
You will partner closely with customers navigating security concerns, internal change management, and reputational risk, while working cross-functionally within DeleteMe to inform product direction, onboarding strategy, and long-term retention. Your book of business will be focused on strategic, high-value accounts with clear retention and growth targets, prioritizing depth of relationship and account planning over transactional volume. As this territory grows, you will help establish the best practices that define what excellent enterprise customer success looks like at DeleteMe.

Responsibilities

Customer Journey Management
-Own the end-to-end customer lifecycle for enterprise sector accounts, including onboarding, implementation, adoption, renewal, and long-term retention.
-Lead structured onboarding and implementation, owning enrollment completion rates and time-to-first-value for each account.
-Manage a clean inbound handoff from Sales and a documented account transition, including a mutual success plan with agreed objectives, milestones, and success metrics established within the first 30 days.
-Maintain account health scores using leading indicators (enrollment rate, engagement, sponsor changes, support trends) and run proactive risk-mitigation plays for at-risk accounts.
-Build and maintain a strategic account plan for each enterprise customer, including stakeholder and organizational mapping, whitespace analysis, and a multi-year engagement roadmap aligned to the customer's priorities.

Value Alignment & Delivery
-Translate DeleteMe's work into risk-reduction outcomes: deliver exposure-reduction reporting and executive-ready metrics that map removals, coverage, and monitoring to each customer's security and risk framework.
-Provide Executive Business Reviews to high-value customers on a defined cadence, revisiting the success plan and quantifying delivered value against the customer's objectives.
-Develop and follow best practices for client engagements, delivering value-adding touchpoints on an ongoing basis.
-Build and maintain trusted, multi-threaded relationships with senior executive sponsors (for example, CISO, General Counsel, or Chief People Officer) and day-to-day champions, ensuring account continuity through sponsor or champion turnover.

Product Adoption
-Drive adoption across complex, multi-stakeholder organizations, including enrollment campaigns, champion enablement, and internal communication strategies for the customer's protected population.
-Act as a product expert for customers, guiding them on new features, coverage expansions, and privacy best practices relevant to their use case.

Renewals & Revenue Retention
-Own renewals and retention for your book of business, including on-time renewal execution, accurate renewal forecasting, and logo-churn mitigation.
-Navigate enterprise renewal mechanics: budget cycles, procurement processes, and multi-approver sign-off, initiating renewal motions early enough to accommodate them.
-Structure and negotiate multi-year renewal agreements, partnering with Legal, Finance, and Account Executives on complex contract terms, pricing structures, and procurement requirements specific to enterprise buyers.

Expansion & Referrals
-Identify and execute expansion opportunities at renewal (seat growth, coverage tiers, additional departments or populations) in partnership with Account Executives.
-Surface mid-year expansion signals and manage a documented handover to Sales, remaining engaged through close.
-Identify referral and advocacy opportunities, contributing to a reference-able pipeline of customers, case studies, and testimonials that elevate the DeleteMe brand across the privacy industry.

Privacy & Security Advisory
-Serve as a subject-matter resource on personal data exposure threats, including doxxing, data broker practices, and the targeting of executives and other high-profile employees, and advise customers on reducing organizational and individual risk.
-Support customer security and compliance workflows, including security questionnaires, data processing agreements, and conversations about DeleteMe's security posture, in partnership with internal Security and Legal teams.

Escalation & Incident Support
-Coordinate urgent exposure escalations (for example, a protected individual who is actively being targeted), partnering with internal operations and analyst teams and managing customer communication with urgency, discretion, and composure.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Voice of Customer
-Collaborate cross-functionally with Account Executives, Product, Support, Marketing, and leadership to deliver a cohesive customer experience.
-Act as the customer's advocate with internal DeleteMe stakeholders, channeling structured feedback into product direction, onboarding strategy, and service improvements.
-Maintain rigorous CRM and Customer Success platform hygiene, including account records, health scores, success plans, and renewal forecasts.

Data Handling & Confidentiality
-Handle rosters and records of protected individuals with strict confidentiality, adhering to DeleteMe's data handling, least-privilege access, and information security policies at all times.

Success Metrics
Performance in this role is measured by:
-Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) and Net Revenue Retention (NRR) for the assigned book of business.
-On-time renewal rate and renewal forecast accuracy.
-Enrollment/adoption rate and time-to-first-value for onboarded accounts.
-Expansion pipeline sourced and expansion revenue closed at renewal.
-Customer satisfaction and advocacy (NPS/CSAT, references, and case studies generated).
-Depth and resilience of executive sponsor relationships, including multi-threading across the account and time-to-reengagement following sponsor or champion turnover.

Experience

-A minimum of 5+ years of experience as a Customer Success Manager, Account Manager, or commensurate experience.
-Experience owning renewals, churn mitigation, and net retention targets in a fast-paced SaaS environment.
-Experience managing a focused portfolio of high-value, strategic enterprise accounts, prioritizing relationship depth and account planning over a high-volume, pooled coverage model, including negotiating multi-year, complex contract renewals.
-Experience working with large enterprise organizations, including familiarity with enterprise procurement processes, budget cycles, and multi-stakeholder buying committees.
-Experience driving product adoption across large, complex organizations and managing sponsor or champion turnover.
-Experience developing deep client relationships to understand client needs and optimize the customer experience.
-Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Support to drive positive customer outcomes.
-Experience with project management principles and effectively managing stakeholder expectations.
-Experience within the Privacy, Security, or Threat Intelligence industry is a strong plus; familiarity with security review processes (security questionnaires, SOC 2, DPAs) is a plus.
-Experience with Customer Success platforms (e.g., Gainsight, ChurnZero, etc) and CRM tools is a plus.

Skills & Qualifications:

-Ability to communicate risk and value to security-minded stakeholders, from practitioners to executives, in clear, credible terms.
-Strong executive presence, with the ability to build trust quickly with senior sponsors and navigate multi-threaded, multi-stakeholder enterprise organizations.
-High degree of discretion and sound judgment when handling sensitive personal information.
-Calm, structured approach to urgent escalations and high-sensitivity situations.
-Excellent critical thinking, problem solving, and written and verbal communication abilities.
-Ability to effectively lead projects and manage stakeholder relationships.
-Positive and collaborative approach to problem solving.
-Preferred candidates are located within the Eastern Time Zone (ET) of the United States.
-Ability to travel up to 20% to support onboarding, implementations, executive meetings, and key enterprise sector engagements.

What We Offer:

Benefits and eligibility may vary based on role, location, employment status, and other factors.

  • 401k retirement plan

  • 20 days of Paid Time Off

  • Cell Phone Reimbursement
  • Fitness Membership Reimbursement

An independent clinical license to practice in good standing (without need for clinical supervision), at the Master or Doctoral levelBC-TMH credential, if required by your state of license

Further, while employees and contractors of Headspace (formerly Ginger) cannot access Headspace products/services, they will be offered benefits according to the company's benefit plan. To ensure we are adhering to best practice and ethical guidelines in the field of mental health, we take care to avoid dual relationships. A dual relationship occurs when a mental health care provider has a second, significantly different relationship with their client in addition to the traditional client-therapist relationship—including, for example, a managerial relationship.

As such, Headspace requests that individuals who have received coaching or clinical services at Headspace wait until their care with Headspace is complete before applying for a position. jobs.title: Founding Deployment Strategist [ERP + AI]
jobs.description:
Founding Deployment Strategist [ERP + AI]

TL;DR

  • We're building the SAP/NetSuite of the AI era for mid-sized companies in the real-world economy, starting with their supply chain operations (buy, sell, stock, produce)

  • Founding deployment strategist: you deploy two things into real factories, in the same project, the ERP that runs their operations, and the AI agents that work inside it. Every client goes from signed contract to go-live on the date we promised, running on Piston, with agents already doing part of the work

  • A rare shape: someone who has led client projects that landed in industrial companies, who is genuinely AI-native, and who will write the deployment playbook for the team and our system integrator partners

  • €3M Pre-seed (Top-tier VCs)

  • €45–60k + equity

What this role is (and isn't)

Most ERP deployments are people moving data around for a year. Incumbents quote six figures for it, and the client gets the same software they had, just newer. Ours run in eight to twelve weeks and deliver two things at once: a new ERP that runs buying, selling, stock and production, and AI agents inside it that read the orders, recompute the production load, prepare the purchases, and ask a human only when it matters.

This is not a product or a sales role, you are a deployment strategist. In one project, you replace a company's ERP and you put AI agents to work inside it.

Why now

Since day one, the founders have run every deployment themselves. Clients are now coming in faster than we can handle, and we need someone to own deployments. You work directly with Eric, CEO, who also leads product. That puts you as close as it gets to what success means at Piston: the success of our clients.

What you'll do

  • Deploy the ERP, with AI. The client's sales, purchasing, stock and production move onto Piston: data migrated from their old ERP and their Excel files, configuration built from their own documents, training, go-live. AI does the heavy lifting, you do the judgment.

  • Put the first AI agents live, during the ERP deployment. You decide what each agent does on its own, what it hands to a human for approval, and you make sure it's still running three months later.

  • Write the deployment playbook. Every go-live feeds a playbook that our next deployment hires and our system integrator partners will follow.

  • Map where the client's time goes. On site, you find the work that eats people's days: re-keying orders, chasing suppliers, rebuilding the same Excel every month. That map is the backlog of the next agents.

  • Teach humans to work with agents. The people you deploy with have never supervised software that acts on its own. You show them how to trust it, check it and correct it.

  • Hold the date and the budget. You size each deployment before the contract and protect that budget.

  • Use the tools engineers build for you. Our engineers build the tools that let you deploy on your own: AI-assisted data migration from the client's old ERP and Excel files, and a builder for screens and agents. You tell them what slows you down, they make it disappear.

  • Agentify your own work. On top of the tools our engineers build, you create your own agents for the deployment itself: configuration checks, test scenarios, training material, status reports. Every manual step you repeat twice becomes an agent for the next deployment.

What you bring

You bring the energy to deploy AI at scale in industrial companies. You learn fast from discovery, and you're as comfortable with founders and leadership teams as with operators on the shop floor.

Must have

  • Customer-facing project experience. Two years or more managing client projects in an industrial environment, typically in consulting (operations, supply chain, transformation). You've held deadlines, managed stakeholders, and delivered.

  • AI-native, for real. You use LLMs every day, and you've built things with them: automations, agents, prompts that run in production (Claude, GPT, n8n, Make, scripts, whatever works). You know what an agent can do alone, where it breaks, and where a human must stay in the loop.

  • Listening before configuring. You translate what people say into what the system and the agents must do, and you notice when the two don't match.

  • At ease in front of clients: Plant directors, finance, shop-floor operators. You can hold a room, and say no in it.

  • A full load, gladly. Around 150 project days a year, several deployments running at once.

  • Fluent English and French, both required. Our first clients work in French, our team writes in English, and you may support our deployments in the United States.

Nice to have

  • You've automated a real operations process end to end, with measurable hours saved

  • You've already taken a complex B2B software live

  • Comfortable with AI

  • You've worked around manufacturing or food operations: lots, BOMs, production orders, campaigns

  • Seed / Series A experience, where nobody's job description holds for long

Talent beats checklists. If you're intrigued, apply anyway.

How we'll measure success

  • ERP go-lives on the date we promised

  • Days spent against the plan we sold

  • Agents still running three months after launch, and the hours of work they take off the client's hands

What you'll get

  • €45–60k + equity

  • World-class peers

  • The first hire of our deployment team: you write the playbook that future hires and our system integrator partners will follow, and you grow with the team it builds

  • A front-row seat on how AI agents change the way real companies operate

  • Regular company offsite (2–4 times per year) in great locations

  • Ideal equipment and setup

  • Remote-first (France), about 20% of your time on client sites

Process

We value efficiency and clarity. The entire process takes no more than 2 weeks:

  1. 30-minute intro call with Florian (CRO)

  2. 60-minute deployment deep dive with Eric (CEO)

  3. 30-min cultural-fit interview with Eugène (CTO)

  4. 2 days paid assessment, on a real client situation.

  5. Offer: If it's a match, we move fast.

Interested? Tell us about a client project you led, and something you automated with AI. A short, personal note goes a long way, AI-generated cover letters don't.

jobs.description:
Product & Tech | Senior Forward Deployed Engineer - AI & Data

Singulier is a strategy, transaction advisory and AI transformation consulting firm supporting private equity funds, portfolio companies and established businesses on their most critical strategic and operational challenges. We combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution to help our clients make better decisions, accelerate value creation and deliver tangible business impact. 

Singulier x OMMAX are joining forces to build a leading European AI management consulting platform, combining deep strategic expertise with technology, data and AI capabilities. Together, we support clients across the full value creation journey, from strategy and due diligence through transformation and execution. 

We operate in a partner-led, entrepreneurial environment where everyone is expected to think critically, take ownership early and work directly with senior stakeholders. 

What you will do 

As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build and deploy AI, data and software solutions directly with our clients.

You are an engineer first: you write production code and take technical ownership of complex projects from discovery through production and handover.

You will work with client teams, alongside Singulier engineers, Product Owners, delivery managers and advisory colleagues:

  • Build and ship: write, review and debug production code. Build applications, integrations, data pipelines and AI workflows or agents that connect models to client data, tools and processes. 
  • Design the solution: translate business priorities into architecture, technical scope and estimates, and make explicit trade-offs between quality, cost and speed. 
  • Run it in production: put in place testing, AI evaluations, access controls, monitoring and deployment suited to the client's systems and constraints. 
  • Drive adoption: understand workflows, test assumptions with users and explain technical choices to engineers and executives. Agree success measures upfront, track adoption and business impact, and hand over with documentation and training. 
  • Lead technically: guide other engineers through design and debugging, coordinate technical dependencies, and turn project work into reusable components and patterns. This is a senior individual contributor role. 

Beyond client work, you will help build the firm: scoping and estimating new projects, interviewing engineering candidates, and contributing to internal AI initiatives and experimentation. 

Work environment : engineering culture and stack 

We are building a small, highly skilled delivery team that shares engineering patterns and goes deep on a focused stack. Our aim is to make AI and technology transformation practical for mid-sized companies, within their budgets, teams and operating realities. Reusing proven foundations across projects lets us deliver faster, with consistent quality and a clear path to business value. 

The stack below is our default, not a constraint: we adapt to client environments and adopt new tools when the benefit is clear. 

  • Ways of working: Git, pull requests, code reviews, automated tests and CI/CD. Monitoring, evaluations and tracing ship with every AI application. 
  • Languages and frameworks: Python, SQL and TypeScript; Polars, FastAPI, Pydantic and Pydantic AI. 
  • Data: PostgreSQL, DuckDB, LanceDB and Parquet, with attention to data quality, modelling and the simplest design that meets performance and scale needs. 
  • Infrastructure: infrastructure as code, Docker, and disciplined configuration, secrets and environment management. Databricks and Google Cloud, including BigQuery, when the workload calls for them. 

You do not need to have used every tool listed. We care about what you have shipped, how you collaborate and what production has taught you. 

Requirements

You will likely bring: 

  • 6+ years as a hands-on engineer in software, data or applied AI, including technical ownership of complex production deployments. 
  • Strong Python, fluent SQL and enough TypeScript to contribute across the stack. 
  • Experience shipping LLM-based solutions to production: evaluating their behaviour and designing around their limitations in real workflows. 
  • Solid grounding in APIs, data modelling, storage and pipelines, and practical experience with cloud services and infrastructure as code. 
  • Strong engineering habits around code review, automated testing and CI/CD, and the judgement to make architecture decisions and guide other engineers. 
  • Comfort in unfamiliar client environments: clarifying ambiguous requirements and discussing scope, commitments and trade-offs with senior stakeholders. 
  • Commercial sense: you care whether what you build moves operational and financial results. 
  • Fluency in French and English. 

Experience in consulting or client-facing delivery, business process automation, or transformation in mid-sized or PE-backed companies would be valuable. A degree in engineering, Computer Science or a related field is welcome, as is equivalent practical experience. 

Why join us 

  • Real impact, in production: what you build changes how our clients operate, and you see the results. 
  • Shape the practice early: join the delivery team while it is still small, and help set its stack, standards and reusable foundations. 
  • Ownership and variety: lead projects end to end across different industries and problems, working directly with business owners, investors and leadership teams. 
  • European scale: be part of the platform Singulier and OMMAX are building, with engineers, data specialists and strategy advisors to learn from. 

Benefits

This is an opportunity to join a fast-growing, partner-led consulting platform at a pivotal moment in its development.

You will work on high-impact AI, Technology and Transformation engagements, advising private equity funds, portfolio companies and executive leadership teams on critical investment and transformation decisions.

As Singulier x OMMAX build a leading European AI management consulting platform, you will help shape how AI, technology, data and business strategy come together to create lasting value for clients.

You will also benefit from significant exposure to Technology Due Diligence, Value Creation and Transformation projects, a steep learning curve, early ownership, close mentorship and the opportunity to contribute to the growth of an entrepreneurial consulting firm operating at European scale.

jobs.description:
Product Designer

Location: UK, central Europe, and Latin America

Remote | Full-time

Compensation: Competitive Compensation

Our client is seeking an experienced, full-time Product Designer to shape the core user experience of their trend intelligence platform. In this role, the designer will play a key part in designing and evolving the platform’s primary dashboard—where brand innovation teams, product marketers, social media teams, and agencies explore trends, generate reports, and interact with LLM-powered features.

As the platform rebuilds around LLM-driven capabilities, the successful candidate will be responsible for defining not just how features look, but how complex data and AI experiences should function. The primary focus is transforming dense, aggregated trend data into clear, intuitive, and actionable insights.

This position joins a close-knit Frontend & UX team reporting directly to the Frontend Lead. The role is 100% remote and open to candidates based between US Central Time (UTC−6) and Central European Time (UTC+1). Candidates must be available during core collaboration hours of 9:00 AM–12:00 PM Eastern Standard Time (2:00 PM–5:00 PM UK / 3:00 PM–6:00 PM CET).

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Product Design: Own features from initial framing to final launch, partnering closely with engineering leadership to deliver written proposals, user flows, prototypes, and Figma specifications.
  • Problem Identification & Solution Design: Independently identify user pain points through customer calls, interviews, user feedback, and usage data to build compelling product proposals.
  • AI & LLM Experience Design: Define user interactions for AI features (chat, automated reports, inline summaries), establish standards for insight attribution and uncertainty handling, and help refine the voice and structure of AI-generated content.
  • Design System Management: Own the principles and Figma library for the design system, partnering with frontend engineers to align with the React component library and establish robust data visualization and AI UX patterns.
  • UX Quality & Feedback Loops: Co-own product metrics, user feedback tracking, and quality evaluation rubrics for LLM outputs alongside the Frontend Lead.

Note: This position focuses strictly on product/UI/UX design. It does not involve writing production code, managing brand/marketing assets, or overseeing back-end API integrations.

Requirements

  • Qualifications
    • Experience: 3+ years of product design experience, ideally owning features end-to-end within a B2B or SaaS platform.
    • Product Thinking: Strong strategic perspective with a proven ability to define what to build and why, backed by a portfolio demonstrating strong problem-framing abilities.
    • Domain Focus: Experience designing data-heavy products, such as dashboards, analytics platforms, or reporting tools.
    • Design Systems: Proven track record of working within and contributing to scalable design component libraries.
    • Tools & AI Integration: High proficiency in Figma, with active integration of AI tools into day-to-day design workflows and a strong curiosity regarding LLM product experiences.
    • Communication: Excellent written English skills, capable of producing clear proposals and documentation in an asynchronous remote environment.
    • Schedule: Location within UTC−6 to UTC+1, with full availability during core collaboration hours (9:00 AM–12:00 PM EST).
  • Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)
    • Experience as the founding or primary designer on a product team.
    • Hands-on experience building or evolving design systems adopted by engineering teams.
    • Direct experience designing AI features or creating evaluation rubrics for LLM output quality.
    • Expertise in advanced data visualization patterns.
    • Familiarity with consumer goods, beauty, food & beverage, or marketing intelligence platforms.
    • Capability to build rapid functional prototypes using AI-assisted tools to evaluate live outputs.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation package tailored to experience.
  • Collaborative, high-impact environment with direct influence on core product direction.
  • Opportunity to work closely alongside senior design leadership.
  • Flexible starting timeline (target start date in January, with early onboarding available).

﻿

Interview Process

  1. Initial Video Screening: A brief introductory video conversation to discuss background, expectations, and role fit.
  2. Personality Assessment: An online assessment to evaluate working style and team dynamics.
  3. Design Leadership Interview: A 30-minute introductory chat with the Lead Designer.
  4. Screen-Recorded Case Study: A flexible, practical exercise (details currently being finalized) to demonstrate hands-on design methodology and execution.
  5. Final Interview: A concluding conversation with key stakeholders to review results and align on next steps.

jobs.title: Mid-Market Implementation Specialist - EMEA
jobs.description:
Mid-Market Implementation Specialist - EMEA

High Touch Implementation Specialist

Hi, I’m Daryl and I’m the Manager of Mid-Market Implementations at Ashby. One of my favorite aspects of Ashby is our operating principle of Continuous Improvement. Coupled with our principle of caring deeply about our customers, we often find ourselves wondering, “What is a better way to accomplish this?”. That’s why I am thrilled to be hiring a Mid-Market Implementation Specialist!

As a member of the Mid-Market Implementation team and part of our growing Professional Services team within Ashby’s Customer Success organization, you’ll have a unique opportunity to help shape this new implementation offering and uplevel the overall customer experience.

About this role:

As an Implementation Specialist aligned to our High Touch segment, you will be responsible for managing and executing the end-to-end implementation of Ashby’s solution for mid-market and smaller enterprise customers. Your book of business will include 15-20 active implementations at a time, each lasting 8-10 weeks. You will work directly with customers to develop and execute implementation plans that ensure a positive customer experience and expedited time to value. Your goal is to support our customers, helping them get up and running swiftly with Ashby so they can achieve their desired outcomes.

Role requirements:

  • Implementation & Project Management: You have extensive experience leading implementation and onboarding projects in high growth B2B SaaS environments, defining scope, aligning stakeholders, communicating project plans, and delivering results against agreed upon expectations. You keep teams on track to meet milestones, work effectively in a remote first setting, and are willing to travel <10% for customer engagements.

  • Technical Proficiency: You have experience with complex, multi-module SaaS systems, understand shared configuration and data models, and are comfortable with analytics, conditional logic, and relational data (Ashby knowledge is a plus but not required)

  • Customer Centricity: You deeply understand customer needs and tailor implementations to meet their specific requirements. You build strong customer relationships by maintaining high levels of engagement and communication; you’re the customer’s proactive guide and advocate throughout the implementation period.

  • Change Management: You are experienced in navigating change management processes and helping customers adapt to new systems and a refreshed approach.

  • Best Practices & Recommendations: You take pride in advising customers on best practices specific to their usage of software to ensure optimal value.

  • Critical Thinking & Solutions Orientation: You proactively address thematic customer opportunities and improve our processes accordingly. You don’t rely on ‘I’ve seen this done,’ but instead think critically to solve problems.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: You effectively partner with cross-functional stakeholders across Customer Success, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Operations to align and define progress.

You could be a great fit if:

  • You demonstrate clear communication. You ask clarifying questions with precision and can distill complex concepts into simple themes.

  • You are a great listener. You see your role as the voice of the customer to internal stakeholders so we can ensure that our offerings continue to evolve in accordance with customer needs.

  • You are a problem solver. You thrive at solving complex challenges with innovative, scalable solutions.

  • ⚡️You know process matters. You are eager to improve processes and workflows to enhance efficiency and efficacy.

  • Your peers describe you as detail-oriented and technically proficient. You take pride in internal operations.

  • You are data-driven. You use metrics and analytics to inform decisions and measure success.

  • You are adaptable. You can navigate changes in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

  • ‍ You love to coach. You see every teaching moment as an opportunity and are excited to help our customers grow.

You might not be a great fit if:

  • You bring project management expertise, but rely on other resources to be technical or product subject matter experts during implementations.

  • You prefer managing shorter implementations of less than 30 days.

  • You typically manage only a few simultaneous implementations at a time. This segment moves with urgency and we balance a book of business from 15-20+ implementations at a time

  • You are accustomed to defining ideas and strategies, yet not responsible for their execution.

  • You prefer working with a simple product (such as a point solution).

  • You prefer exclusively to build (rather than build, iterate, optimize).

Our Philosophy

Here are a few key points (relevant to the go-to-market side) that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us:

  • We spend a lot of time building best-in-class products since we believe a highly differentiated product is a lot easier to sell.

  • We want to offer deep expertise whenever we interact with prospects and customers.

  • We strongly believe that small teams with very talented people (and the right work environment) deliver much better performance than teams with large headcount. We hire and compensate accordingly.

We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over experience, and thoughtful communication (we put a lot of effort into using the right communication channels) - we’ll get into these and other values during the hiring process. You can take a look at our Operating Principles to get a sense of what we are looking for in folks on the team.

The Interview

At Ashby, our team and interview process want to help you show your best self. Our interview process is structured to get to know you and your career as well as empower you with insight into our key focus areas. Here is the process in its entirety:

  • 30 min - Recruiter Screen with Talent Team

  • 45 min - Interview with the Manager, of High Touch Implementations

  • 60 min- Mock Call with Strategic Implementation Specialist and High Touch Implementation Specialist

  • Final Round:

    • 30 min - Cross-Functional Interview with Head of Professional Services

    • 30 min - Product Complexity Interview with VP of Customer Success

    • 30 min - Customer Adoption & Enablement with Manager of High Touch Customer Success and a High Touch Customer Success Manager

    • 10 min - Closing Questions with Hiring Manager

Benefits

  • You’ll get the time to do things the right way; we put a lot of emphasis on high quality work and avoid quick hacks as much as possible.

  • You get to sell a product that our prospects & customers are truly excited about.

  • Competitive compensation is offered.

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO with four weeks is recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it

  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

  • Ensure quality, compliance, and client satisfaction throughout the project/program lifecycle.

Requirements

  • You hold citizenship in one of the 32 NATO member states or the Austrian citizenship;

  • Strong affinity for or demonstrable experience in cybersecurity - understanding of security concepts, terminology, and the challenges clients face (prior direct cybersecurity project experience is a plus, but not mandatory);

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Digital Marketing Manager (m/w/d)

Über YUVENDA

Die YUVENDA Gruppe ist ein führender europäischer Anbieter für innovative Softwarelösungen, die den Mittelstand im Einzelhandel, in der Gastronomie und in konsumnahen Dienstleistungen stärken. Basierend auf best-of-breed Softwaremodulen, unterstützen wir unsere Kunden mit benutzerfreundlichen Lösungen, die einfach zu kombinieren und implementieren sind und die mit ihren Anforderungen mitwachsen.

Für unser Marketing-Team suchen wir ab sofort einen Digital Marketing Manager (m/w/d) in Festanstellung (unbefristet).

Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Business Unit POS & Payment Solutions (YUVENDA POS und YUVENDA Pay). Gleichzeitig verantwortest du über alle Business Units hinweg das Social & Community Management, unsere Marketing Automation Plattform und E-Mail-Marketing. Du berichtest an den Head of Marketing.

Kurz gesagt: Du sorgst dafür, dass aus Reichweite Leads werden – und aus Leads echte Pipeline.

Deine Aufgaben als Digital Marketing Manager

Business Unit Partner POS & Payment Solutions

  • Du bist die zentrale Marketing-Ansprechperson für Sales, Customer Success und Produkt rund um YUVENDA POS und YUVENDA Pay.

  • Du baust echtes Domain-Wissen auf: Zielgruppen, Use Cases, Wettbewerb und Branchenthemen in Handel und Gastronomie.

  • Du planst die Kampagnen-Roadmap der Business Unit – abgestimmt auf Produkt-Releases, Messen und Events.

  • Du übersetzt die Ziele der Business Unit in konkrete Briefings für Content, Social und E-Mail.

  • Du verantwortest den Pipeline-Beitrag deiner Business Unit: Leads, MQLs und SQLs.

Social & Community Management

  • Du entwickelst die Kanalstrategie je Business Unit: Plattform, Frequenz und Ziel.

  • Du erstellst Redaktions- und Postingpläne und setzt sie aus bestehenden Content-Assets um.

  • Du managst unsere Community: Kommentare, DMs und Erwähnungen – mit klar definierten Reaktionszeiten.

  • Du stärkst Employee Advocacy mit Post-Vorlagen für Geschäftsführung und Vertrieb.

  • Du betreibst Social Listening zu unseren Marken und Wettbewerbern.

Marketing Operations & Marketing Automation

  • Du setzt Lead Scoring und die MQL/SQL-Definition gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb um.

  • Du bildest das Lead-Routing zum Vertrieb technisch ab.

  • Du stellst DSGVO-Konformität sicher: Double-Opt-in und Consent-Management.

  • Du dokumentierst unsere Marketing-Prozesse sauber und nachvollziehbar.

E-Mail-Marketing & Nurturing

  • Du planst und versendest Newsletter und E-Mail-Kampagnen.

  • Du baust Nurture-Strecken je Business Unit, Produkt und Persona auf und optimierst sie laufend.

  • Du hältst unsere Listen sauber und sorgst für gute Zustellbarkeit.

Reporting

  • Du misst, was zählt: Reichweite, Engagement, Follower-Qualität, Öffnungs- und Klickraten, Bounce-Quote und Pipeline-Beitrag.

  • Du leitest aus den Zahlen konkrete Optimierungen ab und teilst sie mit dem Team.

Das bringst du mit

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in Marketing, Wirtschaft, Medien oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im digitalen Marketing, idealerweise im B2B- oder SaaS-Umfeld.

  • Praxis mit einer Marketing Automation Plattform (z. B. HubSpot). Workflows, Listen und Lead Scoring sind für dich kein Neuland.

  • Erfahrung im Social Media und Community Management, vor allem auf LinkedIn.

  • Erfahrung im E-Mail-Marketing, inklusive Segmentierung, Automatisierung und DSGVO-Anforderungen.

  • Gutes Gespür für Zielgruppen und Texte – du schreibst gerne und auf den Punkt.

  • Strukturierte, datenorientierte Arbeitsweise und Freude daran, Prozesse sauber aufzusetzen.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du arbeitest gerne eng mit Sales, Produkt und Customer Success zusammen.

  • Interesse an Handel, Gastronomie und Kassensystemen ist ein Plus.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, gute Englischkenntnisse.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Eine unbefristete Festanstellung.

  • Eine Rolle mit echter Verantwortung: Du gestaltest das Marketing einer strategisch wichtigen Business Unit mit und wirkst direkt auf den Unternehmenserfolg.

  • Ein dynamisches, hilfsbereites Team mit flachen Hierarchien.

  • Viel Raum für eigene Ideen und eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten.

  • Weiterentwicklung durch Schulungen, Trainings und Mentoring durch erfahrene Kolleg:innen.

  • Flexibles Arbeiten im hybriden Modell aus Homeoffice und Office.

  • Leistungsorientierte, faire Bezahlung.

Signalling Security Specialist

About the Role

As a Telecom Signalling Security Analyst, you will combine customer-facing delivery with hands-on technical execution in sensitive telecom environments.

You will:

  • Support and operate P1 Security solutions in production contexts (notably PTM and VKB).
  • Conduct signalling security audits using proprietary tooling (notably PTA) and deliver rigorous, professional reports and presentations to customers.

This is a profile-focused role: we are looking for someone who can cover both audit delivery and operational support.

Our teams are remote-first, with a preference for candidates who can overlap working hours with Central European Time.

Tasks

Key Responsibilities

  • Customer delivery & communication

  • Act as a technical point of contact for customers: scoping, updates, and delivery.

  • Deliver presentations, training, and debrief sessions.

  • Signalling Security Audits (PTA)

  • Contribute to audit scoping (objectives, perimeter, constraints, timelines, deliverables).

  • Prepare safe execution plans and operational safeguards.

  • Execute signalling security audits using PTA and associated tooling in a controlled manner.

  • Analyze results, validate findings, and assess exploitability/root cause.

  • Draft professional technical reports in English and present findings to customers.

  • PTM operations & IT support (ticket management)

  • Provide IT support for the PTM IDS in the context of customer ticket workflows.

  • Troubleshoot and maintain PTM deployments, including Linux and virtualization layers.

  • Operate and improve day-to-day tooling/scripts used for investigations, maintenance, and deployments.

  • Collaboration & continuous improvement

  • Work closely with Engineering and R&D to improve tooling, detection quality, and operational processes.

  • Maintain clear internal documentation and handover notes.

Requirements

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Technical writing (English): ability to draft professional, structured technical reports and slide decks

  • Client communication: strong verbal communication skills for presenting and interacting directly with customers.

  • Telecom core & roaming security: solid understanding of telecom core architecture, roaming concepts, and where signalling security fits in real operator environments.

  • Signalling protocols & call flows (hands-on): ability to read and reason about SS7/SIGTRAN, Diameter, LTE/IMS and GTP-C call flows, and connect traces/observations to concrete security findings.

  • Standards-driven audit mindset: familiarity with GSMA Fraud & Security standards (notably FS.11, FS.19, FS.20) and ability to translate requirements into test cases, evidence collection, and actionable remediation.

  • Roaming signalling security: mastery of roaming signalling attacks and call flows.

  • Linux / terminal: comfortable using a terminal and basic Linux commands.

  • Scripting

  • Python: Proficiency in "quick scripting" mode : Ability to develop one-off analysis or testing scripts. No expectations regarding software architecture or code maintainability

  • Bash / shell scripting: ability to write and maintain scripts for operational needs.

  • Virtualization / operations: experience with Linux + ESXi / VM operations (deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance) is a plus

  • Soft skills: customer centered, autonomy, high level of rigor, proactive mindset (ability to propose solutions).

Hiring Process

  1. Initial contact call (10–20 minutes)
  2. Call with the hiring manager (30 minutes)
  3. Capability assessment (role-specific exercise)
  4. Final interview with C-Level and directors (30 minutes)

Energetic Materials Scientist (Munitions)

About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As Energetic Materials Engineer in the Warhead team, you will be the technical authority ensuring the energetic materials in our systems are properly selected, tested and qualified for their intended use. You will build Harmattan AI’s expertise in energetic materials chemistry, stability and supplier assurance, so we can safely and repeatedly source and produce energetics as we scale. You will work daily with systems, warhead and fuze engineers, as well as test facilities and partners.

Responsibilities

  • Act as the internal reference on energetic materials chemistry, properties and compatibility to guide material selection.

  • Baseline the energetic materials requirements and material inventory across our products.

  • Evaluate chemical stability, ageing and environmental sensitivity to define safe-for-use, storage and operational requirements.

  • Develop and oversee material qualification in line with NATO standards, internally and with external partners.

  • Run hands-on material characterization and build the laboratory capability, in-house or through partners, to support it.

  • Assess supplier specifications, process capability and quality requirements to ensure repeatability and traceability, and manage inspections and non-conformances.

  • Support warhead and fuze engineers in sourcing and preparing materials for prototype testing, and report results to systems engineers.

  • Build qualification frameworks and guidance for the wider team, and contribute to growing an internal materials team.

Candidate Requirements

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Chemistry, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering or a related field.

  • Strong understanding of explosive materials, propellants and pyrotechnics, including explosive safety and hazardous materials handling.

  • Hands-on experience with analytical techniques such as DSC, TGA, FTIR and Raman spectroscopy.

  • Experience characterizing and evaluating materials in accordance with NATO qualification standards.

  • Experience running qualification programs for materials used in pyrotechnic or energetic systems.

  • Understanding of materials manufacturing processes and quality controls.

  • Fluency in English required.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Carrier Account Executive

Description

Do you have experience managing carrier networks and want to directly impact commercial success? At CtrlChain, we’re looking for a driven Carrier Account Executive to expand and optimize our carrier network across Europe. 

About us 

Over the past eight years, CtrlChain has built a powerful and trusted ecosystem to simplify and modernize the transport and logistics sector. Now, we're making this ecosystem fully available to our customers, both shippers and carriers. 

Our system brings digital transformation to an industry long reliant on outdated processes, offering smart tools that enhance visibility, streamline compliance, and optimize operations. The result? A more efficient, transparent, and effortless way of working for everyone involved! 

We’re growing fast and expanding our carrier network across Europe. As our network grows, the Carrier Team plays a key role in ensuring carriers are onboarded, activated in our systems, and ready to support our commercial growth. 

The role 

As a Carrier Account Executive, you own a portfolio of carriers and play a key role in expanding capacity, improving margins, and supporting Sales in winning new business. 

You actively build and improve the carrier network, ensuring we have the right capacity, performance, and competitiveness to support growth. You play a key role in improving automation, service KPIs, margins, and win-rate. 

What you’ll do 

Build and scale the carrier network 

  • Proactively expand the carrier base for existing and new lanes  
  • Ensure strong capacity coverage aligned with business needs  
  • Identify and onboard new carriers to improve competitiveness  

Drive onboarding & automation 

  • Onboard and activate carriers in CtrlChain systems  
  • Ensure full system adoption and drive a system-first way of working  
  • Increase automation by ensuring carriers use all relevant tools  

Support Sales & improve win-rate 

  • Work closely with Sales on RFPs and new business  
  • Provide competitive carrier solutions and fast turnaround  
  • Contribute directly to improving win-rate  

Optimize performance & margins 

  • Monitor carrier KPIs and proactively drive improvements  
  • Improve service performance (reliability, responsiveness)  
  • Optimize carrier selection to improve margins  

Deliver insights & improve decisions 

  • Ensure carrier data is accurate, complete, and usable  
  • Provide insights to support pricing, planning, and strategy  
  • Identify structural gaps and improvement opportunities in the network 

Requirements

Who You Are 

You’re commercially aware, proactive, and comfortable working at the intersection of operations and Sales. 

You will thrive in this role if you: 

  • Have 5–8 years of experience in transport, freight forwarding, or logistics coordination. 
  • Have experience with carrier onboarding, communication, and daily operations.  
  • Take a proactive approach to expanding carrier capacity on existing and new lanes.  
  • Are comfortable working with KPIs and continuously improving performance (service, responsiveness, reliability).  
  • Have a system-first mindset and ensure tools are used effectively.  
  • Understand how your work impacts Sales win-rate, margins, and competitiveness.  
  • Are structured, responsive, and take ownership. 
  • Professional level of English and Dutch.
  • Third European language is preferred (ideally German, French, Polish). 

 

Why join CtrlChain? 

  • Direct impact on win-rate, margins, and growth  
  • High ownership and autonomy  
  • Work closely with Sales and commercial teams  
  • Fast-paced scale-up environment  

Benefits

What We Offer

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineering Consultant
jobs.description:
Senior Data Engineering Consultant

Als Senior Data Engineering Consultant bij BigData Republic adviseer je toonaangevende organisaties in Nederland over complexe data-vraagstukken. Je combineert hands-on engineering met een adviserende rol: je schrijft productie-klare code, denkt mee over strategische bedrijfsbeslissingen en begeleidt collega’s om naar een hoger niveau te groeien.

Je hebt je carrière opgebouwd rond het ontwerpen en bouwen van datasystemen. Je werkt graag inhoudelijk mee, maar verliest kwaliteit, schaalbaarheid en duurzaamheid nooit uit het oog. Je bent een ervaren Data Engineer die vaak moeilijk in één functie te vatten is, omdat je op meerdere niveaus impact maakt. En je bent toe aan een nieuwe uitdaging.

Bij BigData Republic ontwikkelen we data-applicaties, bouwen we data-platformen, creëren we voorspellende modellen en ontwerpen we robuuste data-infrastructuren. We werken vanuit een software-engineering mindset, met focus op technische hoogstaande kwaliteit.

Kennisdeling en thought leadership vormen de kern van onze cultuur. Elke vrijdag organiseren we kennissessies op kantoor, we schrijven blogs, organiseren meetups en bezoeken en spreken op conferenties.

Je werkt aan complexe projecten voor grote klanten in uiteenlopende sectoren, terwijl je onderdeel bent van een klein, informeel en hecht team van vakgenoten dat elkaar uitdaagt en inspireert. Bij BigData Republic ben je de expert in de kamer én leer je elke dag van je collega’s. En vooral: je kunt hier jezelf zijn.

In de praktijk besteed je ongeveer 90% van je tijd aan klantprojecten. De overige tijd is expliciet gereserveerd voor eigen initiatieven: een pet project, innovatie of een idee dat je samen met collega’s wilt uitwerken.


Je past goed bij deze rol als je ervaring hebt met (een deel van) onderstaande tooling en concepten:

Je hebt een sterke basis in;

  • Python

  • Cloud (AWS, GCP of Azure)

  • Data pipelines bouwen en ouderhouden (ELT/ ETL)

  • Data warehousing (Databricks, Snowflake of BigQuery)

  • Orchestratie (Airflow, Dagster)

  • Terraform, CI/ CD


Pluspunten, maar geen vereiste:

  • Streaming (Kafka, Spark, Flink)

  • DevOps (Kubernetes)

  • Data Governance en management (bijvoorbeeld dbt)

  • Ervaring met AI en of ML infrastructuur (feature stores, vector databases, ML pipelines)

Je hoeft niet alles te beheersen. Nieuwsgierigheid, leergierigheid en technische diepgang vinden we belangrijker dan een perfecte checklist.



Benefits

  • Vakantiegeld, 8%

  • Bonus- en pensioenregeling

  • 25 Vakantiedagen

  • Hybride werken: de juiste balans tussen thuis, kantoor en klant

  • Vrije keuze in laptop en telefoon

  • Ruimte voor kennisdeling, certificeringen en conferentiebezoek (haal die badge!)

  • Vrijdagmiddagborrels, sportactiviteiten en sociale events (vrijblijvend)

  • Uitdagende én leuke projecten bij aansprekende klanten

  • Een informele cultuur met ruimte voor initiatief en innovatie

Conflux is aangesloten bij de Vereniging van Detacheerders Nederland (VvDN); op deze functie is de CAO voor Detacheerders Nederland (VvDN) van toepassing.

Over BigData Republic
BigData Republic is een high-end consultancybureau gespecialiseerd in data science, data engineering en machine learning. We zijn AI-native en combineren dit met diepgaande engineering kennis. Op deze manier bieden wij onze klanten technische begeleiding tot duurzame en innovatieve oplossingen. Als niche-consultancyteam onderscheiden we ons van de grote spelers: we leveren kwaliteit boven kwantiteit en willen een thought leader in ons vakgebied zijn. Voor onze klanten richten we ons op het creëren van businesswaarde met innovatieve datasolutions die een duurzame impact hebben.
