jobs.title: Senior Accountmanager Zorg & ICT
jobs.description:
Senior Accountmanager Zorg & ICT

Je opent nieuwe deuren bij zorgorganisaties en bouwt vanuit vertrouwen aan nieuwe samenwerkingen.

Wil jij bijdragen aan dienstverlening in de zorg die er echt toe doet? Krijg jij energie van het leggen van nieuwe contacten en het omzetten van een eerste gesprek in een duurzame samenwerking? En geloof jij oprecht dat goede digitale zorg het verschil maakt voor patiënt en zorgprofessional? Dan willen we jou graag leren kennen.

Bij Beter Healthcare draait accountmanagement niet in de eerste plaats om de cijfers. Het draait om mensen, vertrouwen en trots zijn op wat je doet, en om de sterke drive om de zorg én Beter Healthcare stap voor stap vooruit te helpen. Elke dag weer.

Wat je gaat doen

Als (Senior) Accountmanager ben jij voor nieuwe zorgorganisaties vaak de eerste kennismaking met Beter Healthcare. Je richt je op ziekenhuizen, GGZ- en VVT-organisaties en samenwerkingsverbanden waar we nog niet of nauwelijks werken. Je verkoopt geen product, maar dienstverlening: advies, projectmanagement, interim-inzet en implementatie, samen met de consultants die de inhoud brengen.

Je zoekt actief kansen op, weet klant behoeften niet alleen te identificeren maar ook te sturen en laat je niet uit het veld slaan door een nee. Tegelijk verkoop je niets wat niet past: je begint bij echte interesse in de klant en zijn uitdagingen. En je bent een echte teamspeler. Eerst het team, daarna jijzelf. Geen groot ego, geen solist. Je groeit hard mee met ons bedrijf, helemaal in lijn met onze missie: hoe meer we groeien, hoe groter onze positieve impact op de zorg.

Jouw werkzaamheden omvatten onder andere:

·       Je brengt de markt in kaart, kiest doelorganisaties en bouwt een gerichte pipeline op;

·       Je legt contact met CIO's, CMIO's, managers informatievoorziening, inkopers en bestuurders, via je eigen netwerk en actieve acquisitie;

·       Je verkent in gesprekken wat er echt speelt en vertaalt dat samen met consultants naar een passend voorstel;

·       Je stelt offertes op en onderhandelt over inzet, tarieven en voorwaarden;

·       Je volgt aanbestedingen en raamovereenkomsten en coördineert inschrijvingen;

·       Je vertegenwoordigt Beter Healthcare op netwerkevenementen, congressen en vakbijeenkomsten, op een manier die past bij onze waarden: betrokken, betrouwbaar en bekwaam;

·       Je rapporteert over pipeline, forecast en kansen aan het managementteam en hebt dat gewoon goed op orde.


Wie jij bent

Je bent geen typische verkoper. Je bent een ondernemende verbinder: iemand die nieuwe kansen ziet, deuren durft te openen en mensen en organisaties oprecht wil begrijpen. Herken jij jezelf hierin?

·       Je haalt energie uit het binnenhalen van nieuwe klanten en hebt het doorzettingsvermogen dat daarbij hoort;

·       Je hebt een intrinsieke drive om bij te dragen aan betere zorg door digitalisering;

·       Je bent nieuwsgierig en leergierig: de wereld van zorg en ICT blijft je boeien en je houdt je kennis actief bij;

·       Je bent een echte teamspeler en zet het gezamenlijke resultaat boven je eigen ego;

·       Je hebt minimaal acht jaar ervaring in de verkoop van dienstverlening, zoals consultancy, interim of detachering, in de zorg-ICT;

·       Je hebt een trackrecord in het binnenhalen van nieuwe klanten en kent de inkoop- en aanbestedingsprocessen in de zorg;

·       Je beschikt over een actief netwerk bij zorgorganisaties, bij voorkeur op het niveau van CIO, CMIO, IM-management of bestuur;

·       Je hebt hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau;

·       Je communiceert helder en overtuigend in het Nederlands, mondeling en schriftelijk.

Wat je van ons mag verwachten

Bij Beter Healthcare kom je terecht in een werkomgeving die draait om groei, vertrouwen en samenwerking. Je kunt rekenen op:

·       Een goed salaris dat we bepalen op basis van jouw kennis en ervaring;

·       Sterke secundaire voorwaarden, zoals een leaseauto, bonusregeling, pensioen, laptop en telefoon;

·       Een rol met echte impact: jij opent de deuren waardoor Beter Healthcare kan groeien en de zorg kan verbeteren;

·       Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en invloed op onze commerciële koers;

·       Ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen, zowel commercieel als inhoudelijk;

·       Kennisgroepen, intervisies en ontwikkelmogelijkheden om continu te blijven leren;

·       Interactieve kwartaalbijeenkomsten met collega's op inspirerende locaties;

·       Een hecht team van gedreven healthcare consultants dat altijd met je meedenkt;

·       Een actieve personeelsvereniging voor wie het leuk vindt om samen dingen te ondernemen;

·       Heel veel plezier in een prachtig team.

Over Beter Healthcare

Beter Healthcare is een consultancybureau op het snijvlak van zorg en ICT. We ondersteunen zorgorganisaties bij de digitalisering van hun processen en dragen zo bij aan een toekomstbestendige zorg. We zijn al met zo'n 100 IT healthcare specialisten en we groeien hard: niet als doel op zich, maar omdat onze klanten ons nodig hebben en onze aanpak werkt.

Sinds 2012 helpen we zorgorganisaties met advies, projectmanagement en beheer. Onze kracht is dat we niet alleen adviseren, maar ook samen met klanten oplossingen succesvol implementeren. Onze consultants kennen de zorg van binnenuit, en dat maakt echt het verschil.

Beter Healthcare is onderdeel van IG&H, een toonaangevend adviesbureau dat verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor de resultaten van zijn werk. Met de eigen ‘Make Strategy Work’-methodologie richt IG&H zich op digitale transformaties. Binnen IG&H Health werken we samen met teams die gespecialiseerd zijn in onder meer strategy consulting, data en AI, security en managed cloudservices.

Senior Integrated Campaign Manager

At Feedzai, we're building a world of safer money. A world where financial institutions move faster than criminals. Where the payments that fund real lives through salaries, savings, and businesses are protected in real time. We use trusted AI to detect and prevent financial crime, fraud, and money laundering at scale: the world's top banks, payment networks, and acquirers trust our technology to safeguard more than one billion consumers and $9 trillion in payment volume every year.

Feedzai is a Series D company and has raised $282M to date. With a valuation of $2 billion, our technology protects 1 billion consumers and 90 billion transactions each year.

The Marketing Team is empowered to spark change daily with MAP - Mastery in their role, Autonomy to make decisions, and a Purpose to make the world a safer place for all consumers. Using cutting-edge tech and delivering best-in-class content, they influence the trajectory of our company. It’s this team spirit and trust in each other that let us go further together. This team has two simple goals: 1. Everyone in the world knows about the Feedzai brand 2. Making sure our sales team is busy. Join Us!

We’re looking for a strategic, data‑driven Campaign Manager to architect, lead, and orchestrate Feedzai’s largest global marketing campaigns. Feedzai’s campaigns are the connective tissue between brand, product, and growth. As Campaign Manager, you’ll turn business priorities into clear campaign strategies, align cross-functional teams around the plan, and drive the programs that build awareness, generate demand and accelerate pipeline.

You:

You’re a strategic full-funnel marketer who knows how to turn business priorities into clear, measurable campaign strategies. You thrive in complex, fast-moving environments, bringing structure to ambiguity and momentum to cross-functional teams. You’re a natural orchestrator who can build alignment, drive accountability and confidently communicate with senior stakeholders. You stay close to performance, know how to spot what isn’t working, and bring the right teams together to fix it.

Your Day to Day:

  • Design and lead multi-channel, full-funnel campaigns tied to Feedzai’s strategic GTM motions and growth priorities.
  • Translate business priorities into clear campaign goals, audiences, messaging, buyer journeys, routes to market and success metrics.
  • Orchestrate teams across Product Marketing, Digital, Content, Comms, Creative, Regional Marketing, Partner Marketing, ADRs and Sales to deliver against one integrated campaign strategy.
  • Identify critical gaps in audience, market intelligence, positioning, product readiness or sales follow-up and work with the right stakeholders to resolve them.
  • Partner with Product Marketing to translate positioning, buyer insights and product priorities into differentiated full-funnel messaging.
  • Stay close to campaign, lead and pipeline performance, working with Digital, ADRs and Sales to quickly identify issues and optimize messaging, targeting, channels and follow-up.
  • Build campaign enablement that gives Sales and ADR teams the messaging, content and outreach guidance needed to convert engagement and accelerate pipeline.
  • Lead campaign reviews, clearly communicating performance, learnings, risks, recommendations and next steps.
  • Manage multiple complex campaigns at once, bringing structure, accountability and momentum in a fast-moving environment.

You Have & You Know‑How:

  • 8–10+ years of B2B marketing experience, with significant experience leading integrated or demand generation campaigns in SaaS, fintech or enterprise technology.
  • Proven ability to translate business priorities into clear, measurable full-funnel campaign strategies that drive pipeline and revenue impact.
  • Deep understanding of B2B marketing fundamentals, including audience segmentation, ICPs, positioning, buyer journeys, demand generation and pipeline acceleration.
  • Exceptional cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build alignment and drive execution across teams you do not directly manage.
  • Strong project and program management skills, with the ability to juggle multiple complex initiatives, teams and deadlines.
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the confidence to clearly articulate strategy, recommendations and performance to senior leaders.
  • A data-driven mindset, comfortable analyzing campaign and pipeline performance and translating insights into action.
  • Strong marketing judgment, with the ability to identify missing inputs, ask the right questions and keep work moving forward.
  • A self-starter with a bias for action who thrives in high-pressure environments where priorities can change and complete information may not always be available.
  • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, fraud, financial crime, payments, banking technology or enterprise financial services strongly preferred.

You will be immersed in our brand with training, connections, and one-on-one time with your manager. You may shadow your colleagues virtually or onsite at an office depending on where you work as you are supported through your Feedzai journey. Senior Recruiter | GTM Expansion

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

At Ramp, people are the single biggest lever on our trajectory, and the bar for who joins this team gets higher every quarter, not lower. We are hiring our first dedicated Recruiter for GTM Expansion, based in London: someone who can map a market, identify the operators who will outperform their peers and run a full-cycle process that wins them.

The UK is the immediate mandate. You will partner with local and US-based leaders to turn an ambitious growth plan into a real commercial team, from first conversation through offer close. You will also help us build the recruiting approach, market knowledge and candidate networks that support Ramp's expansion into new GTM markets over time.

The recruiters who do this best combine craft on the front end, research, identification and calibration, with execution on the back end, closing, candidate experience and pipeline discipline. We are looking for both.

What You'll Do

• Own full-cycle recruiting for priority GTM Expansion hiring, starting with UK roles across Sales, Solutions Consulting, Partnerships and Customer Success.

• Build a sharp point of view on the UK market and future expansion markets: the companies producing strong talent, the people who outperform their peers and the communities that matter.

• Use research, data and AI as part of your everyday craft to identify and qualify exceptional candidates. We expect a written market point of view, not just a slate of profiles.

• Run thoughtful, personalised outreach grounded in the candidate's actual background, commercial motion or recent work. We care more about quality, replies and conversion than send volume.

• Partner with GTM leaders to turn ambitious hiring plans into a clear profile, credible process and realistic compensation strategy. Surface hard market truth early and push back constructively when needed.

• Own the candidate experience from first conversation through offer close: fast follow-up, clear communication, strong process discipline and a tailored closing plan for the candidates we most want.

• Build real presence for Ramp in London through the right relationships, referrals and targeted community activity. The point is pipeline and credibility, not events for their own sake.

• Work tightly with the wider GTM Recruiting team on calibration, sourcing support, insight and operating rhythm, while bringing strong local judgment.

• Help improve how Ramp recruits for expansion by capturing what works in the UK and applying it thoughtfully as we enter new markets.

What You Need

• 5+ years of full-cycle GTM or Sales recruiting experience, ideally in a high-growth technology company where quality and pace both mattered.

• Strong knowledge of the UK technology talent market and a credible local network, or clear evidence that you can build one quickly.

• A track record of finding and closing exceptional people, not simply running inherited processes. You can point to candidates you identified who became strong hires.

• Excellent sourcing and research instincts. You can explain why someone is genuinely differentiated, not only that they have the right title at the right company.

• Experience hiring across several GTM functions, such as AEs, Sales Leadership, Solutions Consulting, Partnerships, Customer Success or RevOps.

• Strong candidate-closing judgment. You listen closely, understand what each candidate is weighing and can build conviction against serious alternatives.

• The confidence to influence senior leaders, challenge a mis-scoped search and make a hiring process better without creating unnecessary friction.

• Comfort using data to understand funnel health, diagnose problems and hold an honest conversation about what needs to change.

• High ownership. You book the next step while you have the candidate, chase what is stuck and do not wait for a detailed brief to get useful work moving.

• Specific, sharp written communication. Your outreach and candidate updates should never feel template-driven.

Nice to Have

• Experience recruiting for a fintech, SaaS, infrastructure or similarly complex B2B product.

• Experience joining a company as the first recruiter in a new geography, or helping to scale an international business.

• Experience building an AI-augmented recruiting research workflow.

Why this Role

You will have unusual ownership over one of Ramp's most important growth priorities, with the support of an established Talent team rather than the isolation of a one-person recruiting function. The work is practical and high impact: build the UK commercial team, help leaders make better hiring decisions and raise the bar for how Ramp recruits as it enters new markets.

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com.

Life360 is a Remote-First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI Native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Life360's IT team exists to enable our 500+ remote-first employees to be equipped, productive, and secure, wherever they're working from. That means owning the identity, endpoint, infrastructure, and collaboration experience end to end, and treating the services it owns as a product. IT reports to our CISO and sits right next to Information Security, and the two teams work as true partners with decisions made together, not thrown over a wall. That partnership matters even more as Life360 leans further into an AI Native way of working: shaping what that looks like day to day means working closely with other key partners like People, Finance, and Legal, not building in isolation.

About the Job

We're hiring a Director of IT to own IT Operations and IT Engineering end to end; enterprise identity, endpoint management, corporate infrastructure, collaboration tooling, and the service model our distributed workforce depends on. This opportunity will allow you to reimagine how IT operates in an AI Native environment and bring an engineering mindset to how the function runs: structured, automated, and metrics-driven. This is a role for someone who wants to take an IT function to its next stage of maturity, not just keep it running as-is. You’ll have the agency and runway to set the strategy, build the playbooks, and lead the team to the next level.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical leader who has scaled IT operations and engineering in high growth environments, carries strong engineering principles, and can operate with a safety first mindset.

A year in, this function is a genuine strategic partner across the business — anticipating technology and infrastructure needs and building the roadmaps that mature alongside Life360's growth. DeleteMe is the leader in proactive privacy protection. Operating as a fast-growing, global SaaS company, DeleteMe serves both consumers and enterprises. DeleteMe has completed over 100 million opt-out removals, helping customers reduce risks associated with identity theft, spam, doxxing, and other cybersecurity threats. We deliver detailed privacy reports, continuous monitoring, and expert support to ensure ongoing protection.

DeleteMe acts as a scalable, managed defense layer for your most vulnerable attack vector: your people. That’s why 30% of the Fortune 100, top tech firms, major banks, federal agencies, and U.S. states rely on DeleteMe to protect their workforce.

DeleteMe is led by a passionate and experienced team and driven by a powerful mission to empower consumers with privacy.

DeleteMe is looking for a Public Sector Marketing Specialist to help coordinate and execute marketing programs supporting our growing Public Sector business across federal, state, and local government.

It helps them get the most from their ad monetization through in-app bidding, mediation integrations, and high-quality global demand.

The role is based in London and is externally-facing. You'll build and grow partnerships with top-tier gaming and app publishers, with a focus on in-app formats such as rewarded video, interstitial, banner, and native. You'll also help publishers grow their user base by connecting them to InMobi's user acquisition (UA) solutions. Internally, you'll be the link between the publisher ecosystem and InMobi's Product, Demand, Marketplace, and Ad Quality teams, keeping everyone aligned so that partners get results.

Reporting to the Director of Enterprise Gaming, you'll own a book of business across EMEA, shape growth strategy for each partner, and represent InMobi at the major gaming and app industry events. You'll play a central part in strengthening InMobi's position as a leading monetization partner for gaming and apps.

The Impact You'll Make:

  • Represent and manage a portfolio of high-priority gaming and app publishers. Find growth opportunities, manage risks, and build plans that run across several quarters.
  • Take ownership of a defined book of strategic publisher accounts within your first 90 days.
  • Build strong relationships with studios. Learn their monetization stack, game economies, ad formats, and retention goals well enough to spot new opportunities and act on them.
  • Meet or exceed revenue targets every quarter while giving partners an outstanding experience.
  • Grow share of wallet within partners' mediation setups (AppLovin MAX, Google AdMob/Open Bidding, and Unity LevelPlay). Do this through bidding integrations, new placements, format expansion, and better performance.
  • Track key health metrics such as fill rate, eCPM, revenue per daily active user (ARPDAU), ad quality, and margin. Diagnose problems and work with internal teams to fix them.
  • Find cross-sell opportunities: help publishers grow their player base through InMobi's UA offering, and open brand demand for their inventory.
  • Work with Product, Demand, and Marketplace teams to line up supply and demand strategies, including new ad products and direct deals for gaming inventory.
  • Run enablement between publisher partners and internal Sales teams, so that buyers understand the value of gaming audiences and partners adopt new features.
  • Attend key industry events such as Pocket Gamer Connects, Gamesforum, MAU, GDC and Gamescom, and represent InMobi credibly in the gaming ecosystem.
  • Deepen your working technical knowledge of SDK integration, in-app bidding, mediation waterfalls, and how an SSP works.
  • Coach peers to raise the team's capabilities and contribute to the wider team's success.
  • Build growth plans with Business Development, Marketplace, Product, and Engineering, using publisher feedback to shape goals and the product roadmap.

The Experience We Need:

  • A flexible, startup mindset, a strong sense of ownership, and a track record of success in fast-paced, high-growth environments.
  • A proven ability to build, grow, and sell into customer relationships, ideally with existing accounts at mobile gaming or app companies.
  • Success in building account growth plans, influencing decision-makers, and agreeing on shared goals.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. You can draw insight from monetization data, A/B tests, and performance dashboards, and you work well with ambiguity.
  • Experience managing multiple priorities with solid process and project management.
  • Proactive and action-oriented, and comfortable working across functions and time zones.
  • An established network across the EMEA mobile gaming ecosystem, including hubs such as London, Paris, Istanbul, Helsinki, Barcelona, Berlin, and Tel Aviv, and the confidence to meet partners in person at industry events.
  • Hands-on knowledge of in-app monetization: mediation platforms, in-app bidding, ad networks, and SSPs. Experience with UA or performance marketing is a plus.
  • Readiness to learn new systems and keep up with market trends such as privacy changes and mediation dynamics.
  • A collaborative team player with strong interpersonal skills, leadership instincts, and a sense of humor.

At InMobi, you'll be surrounded by people who…

  • Think big and act fast: We're entrepreneurial, thrive in ambiguity, and love solving high-impact problems
  • Are passionate, fanatically driven, and take immense pride in their work: We care deeply about the impact we create and continuously push our potential
  • Own their outcomes: We take responsibility, make bold decisions, and execute with confidence
  • Embrace freedom with accountability: We value autonomy and understand that trust comes with responsibility
  • Believe in lifelong learning: We welcome feedback, challenge ourselves to grow, and aren't afraid to take smart risks

Award-winning culture, best-in-class benefits

Our compensation philosophy enables us to provide a competitive salary that drives high performance while balancing business needs and pay parity. We determine compensation based on a wide variety of factors, including role, nature of experience, skills, and location.

For this role, an InMobian may also receive variable pay in the form of an annual variable bonus or quarterly variable bonus/sales incentive, as deemed per policy, in addition to fixed compensation.

In addition to cash compensation, based on the position, an InMobian can receive equity in the form of ESOPs (Employee Stock Option Plan). We believe that our employees/personnel should have the ability to own a part of the entity they are a part of. Therefore, the entity employing you may elect to provide such stock to you. Ownership of stock enables us to treat our employer company as our own and base our decisions on the company's best interests. To encourage a spirit of shared ownership, we grant InMobians relevant company stock(s). As you contribute to the growth of your company, certain stocks may be issued to you in recognition of your contribution.

If this sounds like the kind of team, role, values, benefits, and challenges that excite you, we'd love to hear from you!

InMobi is an equal opportunity employer
InMobi is a place where everyone can grow. Howsoever you identify, and whatever background you bring with you, we invite you to apply if this sounds like a role that would make you excited to work.

InMobi provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

The InMobi Culture

At InMobi, culture isn't a buzzword; it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences.

We thrive on challenges and seize every opportunity for growth. Our core values — thinking big, being passionate, showing accountability, and taking ownership with freedom — guide us in every decision we make.

We believe in nurturing and investing in your development through continuous learning and career progression with our InMobi Live Your Potential program.

jobs.description:
AWS Data Engineer (Associate)

Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. We exist to ship it: production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores' founders' sister company, which absorbs the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, dependency mapping, validation, test generation, that traditional consulting bills human hours against. Forward-deployed engineers own the rest: architecture, judgment, and cutover, on dates we commit to in the contract.

This role sits in our Data Platform Modernization pillar: consolidating and migrating customer data infrastructure on AWS in weeks, not quarters. Customers come to us with pipelines nobody trusts, metrics nobody agrees on, and warehouses that stall every new business question. You'll build the data products that fix that — working with business leads, analysts, and data scientists to understand the domain, then shipping pipelines and models that hold up in production.

Because Aedeon handles the repetitive layer source discovery, schema mapping, validation harnesses — you won't spend your early career grinding through spreadsheet audits. You'll spend it writing code that reaches production and learning judgment from engineers who own cutovers. Data quality isn't a checkbox here; it's the product.

What you will do?

  • Write efficient PySpark and Amazon Glue code that ships to production.
  • Write SQL in Amazon Athena and Amazon Redshift.
  • Pick up new technologies and techniques and put them to work on real business problems.
  • Work across engineering and business teams to build data products and services people actually use.
  • Deliver projects with the team and land customer updates on time.

What are we looking for?

  • 1 to 3 years of experience in Apache Spark, PySpark, and Amazon Glue.
  • 2+ years of experience writing ETL jobs using PySpark and SparkSQL.
  • 2+ years of experience with SQL queries and stored procedures.
  • Deep understanding of the Dataframe API and the transformation functions supported by Spark 2.7+.

You will be preferred if you have

  • Prior experience in working on AWS EMR, Apache Airflow
  • Certifications AWS Certified Big Data – Specialty OR Cloudera Certified Big Data Engineer OR Hortonworks Certified Big Data Engineer
  • Understanding of DataOps Engineering

How we work?

We run a forward-deployed model. Engineers embed with the customer's team, own outcomes from discovery through production, and carry the delivery commitment personally. Aedeon absorbs scale; engineers absorb judgment; the contract absorbs risk. As an associate, you'll work inside that model from day one shipping alongside senior engineers rather than watching from a bench. The culture is casual and steers clear of rigid corporate habits. We care about what ships, and we let you be yourself while you ship it.

Compensation

Life at Mactores

We care about creating a culture that makes a real difference in the lives of every Mactorian. Our 10 Core Leadership Principles that honor Decision-making, Leadership, Collaboration, and Curiosity drive how we work.

Who is Boulevard?

Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen.

We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most.

Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.

Come Do The Best Work Of Your Life At Boulevard

As an Engineering Manager at Boulevard, you'll lead a team of talented engineers building the platform that powers thousands of self-care businesses. You'll balance technical leadership with people management, fostering a culture of excellence while delivering impactful products across a variety of domains.

Our engineering teams are responsible for developing scalable, reliable, and user-centric solutions that help businesses grow and operate efficiently. Whether working on customer engagement, commerce, scheduling, or core platform capabilities, you’ll play a key role in shaping the future of our product and technology.

  • Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development planning.
  • Partner with Product Management and Design to define and deliver the team roadmap.
  • Drive technical excellence through code reviews and architectural guidance.
  • Build a high-performing team culture focused on collaboration and growth.
  • Manage team delivery, removing blockers, and ensuring successful execution.
  • Contribute to hiring, interviewing, and onboarding new team members.
  • Participate in on-call rotation and lead incident response when needed.
  • Balance hands-on technical contribution with team enablement.

What You'll Need To Thrive:

  • 5+ years of software development experience with 2+ years of people management.
  • Proven ability to lead and develop engineering teams.
  • Strong technical background with the ability to provide architectural guidance.
  • Experience with agile development and delivery management.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • MBA or advanced degree in a related field.

How We'll Take Care Of You:

At Boulevard, we work hard to structure compensation in a way that balances internal equity with local market competitiveness, and we’re happy to share a good-faith estimate of the base salary range for this role. For candidates in NYC, the SF Bay Area, and Seattle, the anticipated base salary range is $173,000 - $216,500 per year. For all other U.S. locations, the anticipated base salary range is $153,500 - $211,200 per year. In addition to this base compensation, this role may be eligible to participate in a variable compensation program. Final compensation will vary based on a variety of factors, which include but are not limited to applicable experience, location, and final leveling.

In addition to the wonderful people you’ll get to work with and challenging projects that’ll push you - Boulevard is here to make sure you’re always at the top of your game emotionally, mentally, and physically.

  • ✨ We’ve got you covered with a 401(k) match plus dental, medical, vision, and life insurance.

  • Take a break whenever you need with our flexible vacation day policy.

  • Fully remote so you can choose where you want to work. You’ll receive a work from home stipend every month.

  • Family planning resources and specialized support programs.

  • Equity: get ahead on the ground floor and grow with Boulevard.

Paid amplification is how our creator work reaches beyond organic. This role sits alongside our Director of Paid Strategy and owns the performance of paid campaigns across our client portfolio — planning them, running them, and being the person in the room who can explain what the numbers mean. You'll also be the senior voice in the paid team, setting the standard for how we test and how we report, and bringing a Paid Media Executive up to speed as the team grows. What you'll do

  • Own the planning, activation, and optimisation of paid campaigns across TikTok and Meta, with YouTube in the mix — from media plan through to post-campaign readout

  • Run a genuine test-and-learn programme against client KPIs: form the hypothesis, structure the test, act on the result, and write down what we learned so the next campaign starts further ahead

  • 5+ years in digital paid media, in-house or agency-side, with deep hands-on ownership of TikTok and Meta

  • Experience managing paid budgets of $1M+ and being accountable for the outcome

  • The judgement to make a call that affects client performance and defend it clearly

  • Real attention to detail on the administrative side: reporting accuracy, budget tracking, and campaign hygiene

A 30-minute intro call with our recruiter, a conversation with the hiring manager, and a panel with 2-3 people from the team you'd be working with. We share feedback within 5 working days at each stage. We tell you what we're paying upfront — no salary games.

 

AI is core to how we operate. Use it to elevate your work. But everything in your application should reflect your own judgement and experience.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Enablement
jobs.description:
Software Engineer, AI Enablement

Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We're seeking a talented and motivated full-time Software Engineer, AI Enablement to help Tailscale's engineering organization get the most out of AI-assisted development. You'll join a small, high-leverage team reporting to our co-founder, working alongside our first AI enablement engineer to build the tools, workflows, and practices that help every engineer at Tailscale build faster and more safely with AI. This is a foundational role — you'll have real latitude to shape what AI enablement means here as we scale, with direct visibility into how the whole engineering org adopts these tools.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with engineering leadership and Tailscale's technical staff to define and drive our internal AI-enablement roadmap.
  • Work closely with the team building Aperture by Tailscale, our AI gateway used both internally and offered as a product.
  • Build and iterate on the tools, workflows, and shared practices that help engineers get real value from coding agents — and evaluate new models and tools, making clear calls on what we adopt.
  • Partner with engineering and non-engineering teams to find high-leverage opportunities to apply AI — this is a support function, so success means other teams shipping faster because of what you've built.
  • Establish the guardrails, review practices, and documentation that make AI-generated code safe to ship, and act as the internal advocate who helps teams adopt good practices without mandating a single tool.
  • Track adoption and measure the real impact of AI tooling on velocity and quality, and report back to leadership.

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Genuine, daily, hands-on fluency with modern AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Pi, or similar) — real power-user experience, not occasional use
  • Experience building and shipping internal tools or developer-facing automation
  • Strong written and verbal communication and internal advocacy skills — comfortable teaching, writing, and influencing engineers at very different comfort levels with AI tooling
  • A balanced approach — trying to get people to use AI effectively and safely where appropriate. We don't have an 'AI mandate'; we believe that if we make AI both easy to use and safe, people will choose to use it when appropriate.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and self-directed prioritization on a small, still-forming team
  • Product or systems thinking — able to identify and prioritize high-leverage opportunities, not just execute a pre-set roadmap

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience in developer experience, platform engineering, or internal tooling
  • Experience evaluating or benchmarking LLMs and coding agents
  • Experience with a systems language such as Go or Rust, in addition to Python
  • Background in security or code-review practices — helpful for reasoning about AI/agent-generated code, though you don't need to be a security engineer
  • Experience in developer relations, technical evangelism, or customer-facing developer advocacy — the same skills that make someone effective in external DevRel translate well to driving internal AI adoption
  • Technical project management experience

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

UK Pay Range

£128,770—£178,540 GBP

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!
  • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.
  • Paid parental leave program. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter.

Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people.

Please be aware that legitimate emails from Tailscale's talent team will only originate from @tailscale.com, @greenhouse.io, and @interviews.modernloop.io email addresses. For more information about protecting yourself from impersonators and scams, please visit https://tailscale.com/scam-awareness.

Full-Time UK

jobs.description:
Enterprise Account Executive

Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more.

We’ve raised $19M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA.

Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era.

About the role

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you’ll be responsible for growing the customer base and closing net-new logos for Infisical’s secrets management platform. We are building the #1 open-source security infrastructure stack, and you will play a defining role in growing it!

You will be working closely with our Head of Sales and the rest of the team on:

  • Understanding and demonstrating our products to prospects.

  • Developing, managing, and closing business within accounts in our enterprise accounts segment.

  • Driving the sales cycle from prospect to close and ensuring adoption and consumption of our products.

  • Collaborating with the engineering team to define customer requirements and communicate timelines.

  • Identifying current customers with upsell and cross-sell opportunities.

  • Using innovative sales tools to map, prospect, follow and close your accounts.

Overall, you’re going to be one of the defining pieces of our team as we scale to thousands of customers over the next 18 months.

Requirements

  • Experience selling software to a technical audience (bonus: knowledge and experience with open source, security, and/or infrastructure sales).

  • Demonstrated experience in scaling sales operations from the ground up, including setting up sales processes, CRM systems, and building a sales team.

  • Credibility, and ability to craft compelling cases for change.

  • Experience in navigating multi-stakeholder sales (e.g., IC engineer, director, executive leadership).

Team, values & benefits

Our team brings experience from companies like Databricks, AWS, Red Hat, and more. We operate primarily as a remote team, but maintain a strong presence in San Francisco, where we have an office. We also get together in person throughout the year for off-sites, conferences, and team gatherings.

At Infisical, we offer competitive compensation, including both salary and equity options. Additional benefits, such as a lunch stipend and a work setup budget, are available with more details to be found on our careers page.
